title: Challenges for human oversight in detecting system malfunctions in AI-assisted medical diagnostics
zh_title: 医师对AI诊断系统故障的监督挑战
summary: 随机对照研究让48名医师使用逐步失灵的AI进行心脏听诊，诊断表现随AI可靠性下降而下降。
key_points: 48名医师随机对照，AI可靠性逐步下降
即便先强制独立判断，诊断表现仍随AI下降
医师信心下降快于对AI信任的下降
reason: 前瞻性随机人机协作实验，但样本仅48名医师，重要档偏下
abstract: Increasingly, physicians must oversee AI systems to detect system malfunctions. We studied 48 physicians in a randomized controlled study using an increasingly malfunctioning AI for cardiac auscultation. Diagnostic performance declined alongside AI reliability, even when physicians were cognitively forced to make an initial classification, and when human performance exceeded AI reliability. Physicians’ confidence declined faster than their trust in AI. Results call for specification of oversight goals and processes ensuring patient safety.
zh_abstract: 越来越多的医生必须监督 AI 系统以检测系统故障。我们在一项随机对照研究中研究了 48 名医生，使用一个故障程度不断增加的 AI 进行心脏听诊。诊断性能随 AI 可靠性下降而下降，即使医生在认知上被强制先做出初始分类，以及即使人类表现超过 AI 可靠性时也是如此。医生的信心下降得比他们对 AI 的信任更快。结果要求明确监督目标和流程以确保患者安全。

title: Multicenter benchmarking of large language models for bladder cancer management recommendations from mpMRI reports
zh_title: 多中心评测LLM生成膀胱癌管理建议
summary: 三中心590份膀胱癌mpMRI报告回顾性评测9个LLM，医生评分显示输入语言与评分关联因模型而异。
key_points: 9个API访问LLM，三院590份mpMRI报告
中文原报告与医生翻译英文两种输入
两名医生1–5分评分，共21,240条评分
reason: 同行评审+三中心外部验证+医生评分，但回顾性、无临床结局，属重要档下限
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can interpret radiology reports, but their ability to generate guideline-concordant recommendations from bladder cancer multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) reports remains uncertain. Following TRIPOD-LLM, we retrospectively evaluated nine API-accessed LLMs using 590 mpMRI reports from three hospitals under two input conditions: original Chinese reports and clinician-translated, quality-controlled English reports. Two physicians independently rated each model-generated recommendation on a 1–5 ordinal scale. We analyzed 21,240 ratings using patient-level random-intercept cumulative link mixed models, with paired Wilcoxon tests as secondary exploratory analyses. The association between input condition and physician rating differed across LLMs (likelihood-ratio chi-square = 683.05, df = 8, P < 0.001). Compared with original Chinese input, clinician-translated English input was associated with higher ratings for chatgpt-o3-pro (OR 2.79, 95% CI 2.29–3.41), deepseek-v4-flash (OR 1.46, 95% CI 1.19–1.81), claude-opus-4-7 (OR 3.07, 95% CI 2.47–3.82), and gpt-5.5 (OR 1.88, 95% CI 1.53–2.32), but with lower ratings for claude-sonnet-4-5 (OR 0.29, 95% CI 0.23–0.36; all Holm-adjusted P < 0.001). Four LLMs showed no clear input-condition difference. Center-specific contrasts also depended on input condition and were materially unchanged after adjustment for age, sex, pathological T stage, tumor grade, tumor number, and maximum lesion diameter. Inter-rater agreement was substantial (quadratic weighted kappa range, 0.621–0.743). Readability did not track physician-rated recommendation quality. These findings argue against clinician-translated English as a universal optimization strategy and support model-specific validation of input conditions before clinical deployment. LLM-generated recommendations from mpMRI reports are best positioned as clinician-supervised, imaging-based decision support rather than standalone treatment advice.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）能够解读放射学报告，但其从膀胱癌多参数 MRI（mpMRI）报告生成符合指南建议的能力仍不确定。遵循 TRIPOD-LLM，我们回顾性评估了九个通过 API 访问的 LLM，使用来自三家医院的 590 份 mpMRI 报告，在两种输入条件下进行：原始中文报告和由临床医生翻译并经过质量控制的英文报告。两名医生独立按 1–5 顺序量表对每个模型生成的建议评分。我们使用患者水平随机截距累积链接混合模型分析 21,240 个评分，并以配对 Wilcoxon 检验作为次要探索性分析。输入条件与医生评分之间的关联因 LLM 而异（似然比卡方 = 683.05，df = 8，P < 0.001）。与原始中文输入相比，临床医生翻译的英文输入与 chatgpt-o3-pro（OR 2.79，95% CI 2.29–3.41）、deepseek-v4-flash（OR 1.46，95% CI 1.19–1.81）、claude-opus-4-7（OR 3.07，95% CI 2.47–3.82）和 gpt-5.5（OR 1.88，95% CI 1.53–2.32）的更高评分相关，但与 claude-sonnet-4-5 的更低评分相关（OR 0.29，95% CI 0.23–0.36；所有 Holm 校正 P < 0.001）。四个 LLM 未显示明确的输入条件差异。中心特异性对比也取决于输入条件，并且在调整年龄、性别、病理 T 分期、肿瘤分级、肿瘤数目和最大病灶直径后基本未变。评分者间一致性达到实质性水平（二次加权 kappa 范围 0.621–0.743）。可读性并未随医生评定的建议质量变化。这些发现反对将临床医生翻译的英文作为通用优化策略，并支持在临床部署前对输入条件进行模型特异性验证。来自 mpMRI 报告的 LLM 生成建议最好定位为临床医生监督下基于影像的决策支持，而非独立的治疗建议。

title: Learning uncertainty fields for joint brain stroke diagnosis and intrinsic lesion localization in CT and MRI
zh_title: 多中心CT/MRI联合卒中诊断与病灶定位的不确定性场模型
summary: 提出DFE-Net，用可学习模糊隶属度场表达空间不确定性，在多中心CT与MRI队列上联合分类卒中并定位病灶。
key_points: CT队列6650例8873张图像，MRI队列67例615张图像
CT病灶定位对比专家标注Dice为0.70
reason: 多中心大样本影像研究，但无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Early stroke changes can be difficult to detect and localize on neuroimaging, particularly when lesion boundaries are indistinct. We developed the Dynamic Fuzzy Encoder Network (DFE-Net), which uses learnable fuzzy membership fields to represent spatial uncertainty and jointly classify stroke and localize lesions. We evaluated the model on a multicentre computed tomography (CT) cohort comprising 6650 patients and 8873 images and a separate magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) cohort comprising 67 patients and 615 images. Training and testing were performed separately within each modality. DFE-Net achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.974 and an F1 score of 0.897 on CT, and corresponding values of 0.978 and 0.879 on MRI. In the CT cohort, lesion localization against expert annotations yielded a Dice score of 0.70. MRI localization was assessed using gradient-derived pseudo-targets because expert lesion masks were unavailable. Expected calibration error was ~0.022 in both cohorts, and the model contained 0.20 million parameters. These results support joint diagnosis and spatial localization with a compact model, while prospective validation and expert-annotated MRI evaluation remain necessary.
zh_abstract: 早期卒中改变在神经影像上可能难以检测和定位，尤其是当病灶边界不清晰时。我们开发了动态模糊编码器网络（Dynamic Fuzzy Encoder Network，DFE-Net），该网络使用可学习的模糊隶属场来表示空间不确定性，并联合进行卒中分类和病灶定位。我们在一个包含6650例患者和8873幅图像的多中心计算机断层扫描（computed tomography，CT）队列，以及一个包含67例患者和615幅图像的独立磁共振成像（magnetic resonance imaging，MRI）队列上评估了该模型。训练和测试均在每种模态内分别进行。DFE-Net在CT上达到受试者工作特征曲线下面积（area under the receiver operating characteristic curve，AUROC）0.974和F1分数0.897，在MRI上相应数值分别为0.978和0.879。在CT队列中，对照专家标注进行病灶定位得到的Dice分数为0.70。由于无法获得专家病灶掩膜，MRI定位使用基于梯度衍生的伪目标进行评估。两个队列中的期望校准误差均约为0.022，模型包含0.20百万个参数。这些结果支持使用紧凑模型进行联合诊断和空间定位，但仍需开展前瞻性验证和由专家标注的MRI评估。

title: Enhanced skin tone and blood estimation through AI-enabled upscaling of discrete reflectance spectra
zh_title: AI 光谱上采样提升肤色与血容量估计
summary: npj Digital Medicine 研究用全连接网络对稀疏漫反射光谱上采样，估计黑色素与血液指标。
key_points: 在体模、猪皮与人体上验证
体模 R²>0.90，猪皮黑色素 r=0.95
面向脉搏血氧仪肤色偏差问题
reason: 同行评审方法研究，多平台验证但无临床结局
abstract: Objective quantification of epidermal melanin content and dermal blood volume is crucial for equitable applications in dermatology and in the evaluation and engineering of optical devices, such as pulse oximeters, where variable amounts of melanin may introduce inaccuracies. Here, we demonstrate a method leveraging diffuse reflectance spectroscopy and a machine-learning framework using fully connected neural networks (FCNNs) to non-invasively estimate melanin and blood indices from sparse data through spectral upscaling. We validated the algorithm on custom phantoms, porcine skin, and in vivo human participants. In phantoms with variable blood and melanin (0–20%), the model achieved high accuracy ( R ^2 > 0.90) to absolute concentrations. In porcine skin, estimated melanin strongly correlated with histology-derived density scores (Pearson r = 0.95). Across six regions of the human hand, the FCNN accurately estimated pigmentation from sparse wavelengths, even during hand-raise challenges that induce confounding blood volume changes. After upscaling, sparse-wavelength estimates strongly correlated with a model using over 450 wavelengths (Pearson r = 0.96), reducing data requirements ~ 150-fold without compromising accuracy. These findings highlight the importance of high-spectral information for disentangling melanin and blood contributions in reflectance spectra and the capacity of machine-learning to restore predictive performance from sparse inputs. These findings demonstrate that artificial-intelligence -driven spectral upscaling can enhance objective skin tone quantification in wearable optical devices.
zh_abstract: 对表皮黑色素含量和真皮血容量进行客观定量，对于皮肤病学中的公平应用，以及对于脉氧仪等光学设备的评估与工程化至关重要；在这些设备中，不同含量的黑色素可能引入不准确性。在此，我们展示了一种方法，利用漫反射光谱和基于全连接神经网络（fully connected neural networks, FCNN）的机器学习框架，通过光谱上采样从稀疏数据中无创估计黑色素和血液指标。我们在定制体模、猪皮肤和人类在体参与者上验证了该算法。在血液和黑色素可变（0–20%）的体模中，该模型对绝对浓度达到了高准确度（R^2 > 0.90）。在猪皮肤中，估计的黑色素与组织学衍生的密度评分强相关（Pearson r = 0.95）。在人类手部的六个区域中，FCNN能够从稀疏波长准确估计色素沉着，即使在诱导混杂血容量变化的抬手挑战期间也是如此。经上采样后，稀疏波长估计值与使用超过450个波长的模型强相关（Pearson r = 0.96），在不损害准确度的情况下将数据需求减少约150倍。这些发现突出了高光谱信息在分离反射光谱中黑色素和血液贡献方面的重要性，以及机器学习从稀疏输入恢复预测性能的能力。这些发现表明，人工智能驱动的光谱上采样可以增强可穿戴光学设备中皮肤色调的客观定量。

title: Deep learning detection and biological interpretation of arterial stiffness from retinal fundus images in diabetes.
zh_title: 眼底图像深度学习检测糖尿病动脉僵硬
summary: 多中心研究用眼底图像预测动脉僵硬，训练6.4万张图像，两家独立医院外部验证AUC约0.77至0.80。
key_points: 训练64,440张图像，外部验证6,217张
内部AUC 0.780，外部验证0.772
融合临床因素AUC 0.853
reason: 同行评审大样本并有两家独立医院外部验证，属重要档
abstract: [iScience] Pulse wave velocity is the gold standard for assessing arterial stiffness (AS) but is costly and not widely accessible. This multicenter study developed a deep learning model to predict AS from fundus images. Trained on 64,440 images from 36,412 adults with diabetes at China's National Metabolic Management Centers and externally validated on 6,217 images from two independent hospitals, the model achieved an AUC of 0.780 (95% CI: 0.769-0.792) and 0.772 (95% CI: 0.754-0.790) in internal and external validation, respectively, outperforming models using classical risk factors alone. The fusion model integrating fundus images with clinical factors significantly improved test-set performance (AUC = 0.853, 95% CI: 0.844-0.863) and demonstrated good external generalizability (AUC = 0.801, 95% CI: 0.784-0.816). Ablation studies indicated retinal arteries were associated with AS, with other retinal structures also contributing. These findings support deep-learning-based fundus-image analysis for AS screening in real-world clinical settings, and retinal-structure analyses for exploring AS pathophysiology.
zh_abstract: [iScience] 脉搏波速度是评估动脉僵硬度（AS）的金标准，但成本高且不易广泛获取。这项多中心研究开发了一种深度学习模型，用眼底图像预测AS。该模型在中国国家代谢管理中心的36,412名成人糖尿病患者的64,440张图像上训练，并在两家独立医院的6,217张图像上进行外部验证，在内部验证和外部验证中分别达到AUC 0.780（95% CI：0.769-0.792）和0.772（95% CI：0.754-0.790），优于仅使用经典危险因素的模型。融合眼底图像与临床因素的融合模型显著改善了测试集性能（AUC = 0.853，95% CI：0.844-0.863），并表现出良好的外部泛化性（AUC = 0.801，95% CI：0.784-0.816）。消融研究表明视网膜动脉与AS相关，其他视网膜结构也有贡献。这些发现支持在真实世界临床环境中使用基于深度学习的眼底图像分析进行AS筛查，并支持通过视网膜结构分析探索AS病理生理学。

title: Physics-based simulation unlocks scaling laws for generalizable MRI reconstruction
zh_title: 物理仿真训练解锁 MRI 重建泛化缩放规律
summary: 预印本提出 SIM 框架，以物理仿真数据与算力扩展实现零样本 MRI 重建，跨14个数据集验证。
key_points: 协同设计仿真训练数据、模型架构与学习范式
覆盖7个中心、5家厂商、0.3–7T 场强
在14个公开与自建数据集上评估零样本重建
reason: 多中心跨厂商外部验证且方法新颖，但为预印本，封顶8分，定7分。
abstract: Deep-learning-based magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) reconstruction holds great promise for accelerating acquisitions, yet its clinical translation remains bottlenecked by poor generalizability across unseen scanners, populations, anatomies, and protocols. Gathering sufficiently diverse clinical datasets to overcome this bottleneck is hindered by high acquisition costs, privacy restrictions, and institutional biases. Here, we introduce Scalable Inverse Model (SIM), a framework that systematically co-designs physics-simulated training data, model architecture, and learning paradigms around scalability--leveraging compute scaling to overcome historical data bottlenecks and achieve robust zero-shot MRI reconstruction. Across 14 public and in-house datasets--spanning seven international centers, five vendors, field strengths of 0.3-7 T, over ten anatomical regions, more than ten acquisition protocols, downstream quantitative and molecular tasks, and a 150-scan blinded radiologist study--SIM demonstrates robust zero-shot generalizability, recovering fine anatomical details while suppressing aliasing artifacts where conventional deep-learning methods fail. Attention-map analyses confirm that SIM learns physically explainable, dynamically adaptive reconstruction primitives rather than anatomy-specific priors. SIM establishes a scalable, privacy-preserving, and democratized infrastructure for universal MRI reconstruction, providing a blueprint for generalizable AI across inverse problems in medical imaging.
zh_abstract: 基于深度学习的磁共振成像（MRI）重建在加速采集方面具有巨大前景，但其临床转化仍受制于在未见过的扫描仪、人群、解剖部位和成像协议之间泛化能力差这一瓶颈。获取足够多样的临床数据集以克服该瓶颈受到高采集成本、隐私限制和机构偏倚的阻碍。在此，我们提出可扩展逆模型（Scalable Inverse Model, SIM），一个围绕可扩展性系统性地协同设计物理模拟训练数据、模型架构和学习范式的框架——利用计算扩展来克服历史数据瓶颈，并实现稳健的零样本MRI重建。在14个公共和内部数据集上——跨越七个国际中心、五家厂商、0.3–7 T的场强、十多个解剖区域、十多种采集协议、下游定量和分子任务，以及一项150次扫描的盲法放射科医师研究——SIM展现出稳健的零样本泛化能力，在传统深度学习方法失败之处恢复精细解剖细节，同时抑制混叠伪影。注意力图分析证实，SIM学习到的是物理上可解释、动态自适应的重建基元，而非针对特定解剖部位的先验。SIM为通用MRI重建建立了一个可扩展、隐私保护且民主化的基础设施，为医学影像逆问题中可泛化的人工智能提供了蓝图。

title: Large Language Model-Assisted Discharge Instructions for Diabetic Kidney Disease: Comparative Evaluation Study.
zh_title: 大模型辅助糖尿病肾病出院指导评估
summary: JMIR 研究纳入101例患者，比较住院医师独立撰写与 DeepSeek 辅助生成的出院指导质量。
key_points: 纳入101例糖尿病肾病患者
对比低年资医师与 AI 辅助组
按 CKD 分期分析效果差异
reason: 单中心、百余例、无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: [JMIR medical informatics] Discharge instructions are an important component of the transition from hospital to home for patients with diabetic kidney disease (DKD), whose care often involves multiple comorbidities, medications, and stage-specific management needs. However, producing complete, accurate, clear, and personalized instructions can be challenging for junior physicians. This study aimed to evaluate whether large language model (LLM) assistance improves the quality of DKD discharge instructions produced by junior physicians and whether its benefits vary according to chronic kidney disease (CKD) stage. The study included 101 hospitalized patients with DKD. Discharge instructions for each patient were initially drafted by a group of junior residents (resident group); subsequently, another group of residents at the same level, with the assistance of DeepSeek-V3.2 (AI-assisted group), generated a separate set of discharge instructions for the same 101 patients, resulting in a total of 202 documents. Four clinical experts, including 2 nephrologists and 2 endocrinologists, independently scored both versions of the discharge instructions using a 5-point Likert scale across 5 dimensions: completeness, accuracy, safety, clarity, and personalization. Interrater reliability was assessed using the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC). Interrater reliability was excellent in both the resident group (ICC=0.817, 95% CI 0.763-0.864; P .05). The proportion of cases achieving a ≥1-point improvement in overall quality was 99% (100/101; 95% CI 94.6%-100.0%). LLM assistance improved the completeness, clarity, and personalization of DKD discharge instructions generated by junior physicians, with advantages greatest in complex cases. A human-AI collaborative model is a promising approach to reduce documentation burden.
zh_abstract: [JMIR medical informatics] 出院指导是糖尿病肾病（diabetic kidney disease, DKD）患者从医院过渡到家庭的重要组成部分，这类患者的照护通常涉及多种合并症、多种药物以及特定分期的管理需求。然而，对于低年资医生而言，生成完整、准确、清晰且个性化的出院指导可能具有挑战性。本研究旨在评估大语言模型（large language model, LLM）辅助是否能提高低年资医生生成的DKD出院指导质量，以及其益处是否因慢性肾脏病（chronic kidney disease, CKD）分期而异。该研究纳入101例住院DKD患者。每例患者的出院指导最初由一组低年资住院医师起草（住院医师组）；随后，另一组同等水平的住院医师在DeepSeek-V3.2辅助下（AI辅助组），为同样的101例患者生成了一套单独的出院指导，共产生202份文件。4名临床专家（包括2名肾内科医生和2名内分泌科医生）使用5分Likert量表，从完整性、准确性、安全性、清晰性和个性化5个维度对两版出院指导独立评分。评分者间信度采用组内相关系数（intraclass correlation coefficient, ICC）评估。住院医师组（ICC=0.817，95% CI 0.763-0.864；P .05）的评分者间信度均为优秀。总体质量获得≥1分改善的病例比例为99%（100/101；95% CI 94.6%-100.0%）。LLM辅助提高了低年资医生生成的DKD出院指导的完整性、清晰性和个性化，且在复杂病例中优势最大。人-AI协作模式是减轻文书负担的一种有前景的方法。

title: Artificial Intelligence Assisted Innovative Low-cost Skin Testing Model to Accelerate Person-centered TB Prevention Services in Tanzania, Mozambique and Uganda
zh_title: AI 辅助低成本皮肤试验加速结核预防（TEST4TPT）
summary: 三国多中心试验注册，计划入组1804例，评估 AI 辅助判读结核感染皮肤试验。
key_points: 坦桑尼亚、莫桑比克、乌干达三国

abstract: [Clinical medicine (London, England)] Artificial intelligence (AI) has moved from novelty to daily use in internal medicine: ambient documentation, point-of-care literature synthesis and diagnostic support are already in routine use. This review describes the skills needed to use these tools safely: critical appraisal of the evidence behind a tool, oversight of generated documents against the source record, verification of factual claims, calibration of trust to demonstrated reliability, and lawful handling of identifiable patient data. We summarise the drivers of adoption, the measured benefits, the characteristic failure modes, and how physicians can acquire these skills through continuing professional development.

title: Artificial intelligence-driven multiple sclerosis diagnosis using genomic and medical imaging data: a review.
zh_title: AI结合基因组与影像诊断多发性硬化综述
summary: 遵循PRISMA的系统综述纳入26项研究，评估AI利用MRI、OCT、转录组等多模态数据诊断多发性硬化。
key_points: 按PRISMA纳入26项研究
涵盖MRI、视网膜OCT、血液转录组与SNP
关注诊断准确率与疾病进展评估
reason: 系统综述纳入26项研究，结论较明确，属值得一看档
abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] Multiple Sclerosis (MS) is an immune-mediated central nervous system condition with heterogeneous clinical manifestations, progressive neurodegeneration, and considerable variability in disease trajectory. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly machine learning (ML) methods, have improved MS diagnosis and risk prediction. However, comprehensive review studies emphasizing the potential of existing AI-powered MS diagnosis remain limited. Thus, this study investigates the utilization of multimodal data by AI models to enhance diagnostic accuracy, evaluate disease progression, and optimize personalized care strategies. By adhering to PRISMA guidelines, this review included 26 studies encompassing MRI-based analysis, retinal OCT imaging, blood transcriptomics, SNP genotyping, and multimodal clinical datasets. An additional classification of these studies by modality was performed, and they were assessed with respect to dataset size, performance metrics, biomarkers, methodological robustness, and model interpretability. The findings indicate a consistent trend toward outstanding diagnostic performance, with some AI models achieving accuracies exceeding 95% using medical imaging and genomic data. However, limited external validation and interpretability procedures create a gap in clinical applicability and trustworthiness. This review highlights AI's growing potential to revolutionize MS diagnosis.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] 多发性硬化（MS）是一种免疫介导的中枢神经系统疾病，具有异质性临床表现、进行性神经退行性变以及疾病轨迹的显著变异性。人工智能（AI）的最新进展，尤其是机器学习（ML）方法，改善了MS的诊断和风险预测。然而，强调现有AI驱动的MS诊断潜力的综合性综述研究仍然有限。因此，本研究探讨AI模型对多模态数据的利用，以提高诊断准确性、评估疾病进展并优化个性化照护策略。遵循PRISMA指南，本综述纳入26项研究，涵盖基于MRI的分析、视网膜OCT成像、血液转录组学、SNP基因分型以及多模态临床数据集。还对这些研究按模态进行了额外分类，并从数据集规模、性能指标、生物标志物、方法学稳健性和模型可解释性方面进行了评估。研究结果显示出朝着卓越诊断性能发展的一致趋势，一些AI模型利用医学影像和基因组数据达到超过95%的准确率。然而，有限的外部验证和可解释性程序在临床适用性和可信度方面造成了差距。本综述强调了AI在革新MS诊断方面日益增长的潜力。

title: Reliability-Aware Clinical Relation Learning for Uncertainty-Robust Multi-Label Chest X-ray Classification
zh_title: ReCaRL：可靠性感知关系学习的胸片多标签分类
summary: 预印本提出基于标签关联图与可靠性加权的胸片多标签分类框架，以应对标签噪声，并含内部与外部验证。
key_points: 用训练标签关联构图并进行可靠性加权更新
以观测掩码处理不确定标注
与平坦、加权、层级等多类基线对比
reason: 预印本方法研究且含外部验证，但未经同行评审
abstract: Background: Automated multi-label classification of chest radiographs is complicated by overlapping imaging findings, noisy report-derived labels, and changes in disease co-occurrence across clinical settings. Existing clinical-hierarchy methods can encode label relationships, but a rigid hierarchy may conflate categorical membership with empirical association and propagate annotation errors. Methods: We investigated Reliability-Aware Clinical Relation Learning (ReCaRL), a graph-assisted framework for multi-label chest radiograph classification. An image encoder produces initial finding scores, while a graph constructed from training-label associations provides reliability-weighted, confidence-gated updates. Uncertain annotations are handled with observation masks. The evaluation compares flat, weighted, graph-based, and hierarchy-penalty baselines, with internal and external discrimination and calibration assessments. Results: In the internal evaluation, ReCaRL achieved macro AUROC 0.821 and macro AUPRC 0.437, compared with 0.812 and 0.423 for the masked/weighted baseline. Mean AUROC across five common findings was 0.865 versus 0.858. External testing yielded AUROC 0.799 and AUPRC 0.409. Post-hoc calibration reduced the internal Brier score from 0.113 to 0.102 and the external expected calibration error from 0.082 to 0.061, without changing AUROC or AUPRC. Conclusions: Reliability-aware graph propagation and confidence gating were associated with modest improvements in multi-label chest radiograph classification relative to the matched masked/weighted baseline. Post-hoc calibration improved probability reliability in the reported evaluations. The findings do not establish a benefit in prospective clinical decision-making.
zh_abstract:
【背景】胸部X线片的多标签自动分类因影像表现重叠、由报告衍生的标签存在噪声以及不同临床环境中疾病共现情况变化而变得复杂。现有的临床层级方法可以编码标签关系，但僵化的层级可能将类别归属与经验关联混为一谈，并传播标注错误。

【方法】我们研究了Reliability-Aware Clinical Relation Learning（ReCaRL，可靠性感知临床关系学习），一种用于多标签胸部X线片分类的图辅助框架。图像编码器产生初始发现评分，而由训练标签关联构建的图提供可靠性加权、置信度门控的更新。不确定标注通过观察掩码处理。评估比较了扁平、加权、基于图和层级惩罚基线，并进行了内部和外部判别与校准评估。

【结果】在内部评估中，ReCaRL达到宏AUROC 0.821和宏AUPRC 0.437，而掩蔽/加权基线为0.812和0.423。五种常见发现的平均AUROC为0.865，对比0.858。外部测试得到AUROC 0.799和AUPRC 0.409。事后校准将内部Brier评分从0.113降至0.102，并将外部期望校准误差从0.082降至0.061，而AUROC或AUPRC未发生变化。

【结论】相对于匹配的掩蔽/加权基线，可靠性感知图传播和置信度门控与多标签胸部X线片分类的适度改善相关。事后校准在报告的评估中改善了概率可靠性。这些发现并未确立在前瞻性临床决策中的获益。

title: TuMAP: A Dual-View, Morphotype-Aware Pathomics Pipeline for Quantifying Renal Tubular Remodeling
zh_title: TuMAP：肾小管重构的病理组学量化流程
summary: 提出双视角、形态型感知的病理组学流程，在358张肾活检切片中识别八种小管形态型并做患者层面统计。
key_points: 分析456,158条小管、358张切片
识别8种形态型，7种子采样稳定
219例患者6个诊断组比例差异
reason: 规模较大的病理组学预印本新方法，但未见外部验证或开放代码
abstract: Quantifying disease-associated renal tubular remodeling is challenging because tubular appearances are heterogeneous. We introduce TuMAP (Tubular Morphotype-Aware Pathomics), a pipeline combining (1) dual-view foundation-model representations and provisional morphotype annotation, (2) compositional and within-morphotype pathomics, and (3) patient-level statistical inference. From 456,158 tubules in 358 PAS-stained kidney biopsy slides, TuMAP identified eight image-based morphotypes, seven of which showed stable subsampling assignments. Across 219 patients in six diagnostic groups, diabetic nephropathy (DN) and tubulointerstitial nephritis/acute tubular injury (TIN/ATI) each differed from minimal change disease in seven morphotype proportions, while IgA nephropathy differed in six. DN showed reduced nuclear solidity and increased eccentricity across all eight morphotypes. Area-normalized nuclear density exposed additional within-morphotype differences. TuMAP provides a framework for separating changes in tubular morphotype composition from phenotypic differences within morphotypes.
zh_abstract: 量化疾病相关的肾小管重塑具有挑战性，因为肾小管形态具有异质性。我们介绍TuMAP（Tubular Morphotype-Aware Pathomics，肾小管形态型感知病理组学），一个结合以下内容的流程：（1）双视图基础模型表征和临时形态型注释；（2）组成性和形态型内病理组学；（3）患者水平统计推断。从358张PAS染色的肾活检切片中的456,158个肾小管中，TuMAP识别出八种基于图像的形态型，其中七种在子采样分配中表现稳定。在六个诊断组的219名患者中，糖尿病肾病（DN）和肾小管间质性肾炎/急性肾小管损伤（TIN/ATI）各自在七种形态型比例上与微小病变肾病不同，而IgA肾病在六种形态型比例上不同。DN在所有八种形态型中均显示核实度降低和偏心度增加。面积归一化核密度揭示了额外的形态型内差异。TuMAP提供了一个框架，用于将肾小管形态型组成的变化与形态型内的表型差异区分开来。

title: Curiosity-0826-4B: Generative Medical Event Sequence Modeling Across Pediatric and Adult Populations
zh_title: Curiosity-0826-4B：跨儿科与成人的医疗事件生成模型
summary: arXiv 预印本发布在 Epic Cosmos 上训练的医疗事件基础模型，可零样本预测临床事件。
key_points: 覆盖儿科与成人人群
检验值预测 MAE 降低18–46%
哮喘、镰状细胞危象 AUROC 约0.74–0.85
reason: 大规模 EHR 基础模型但为预印本、缺外部验证
abstract: We introduce Curiosity-0826-4B, an updated version of the generative medical event foundation model trained on Epic Cosmos that simulates patient timelines to produce zero-shot clinical predictions. Curiosity-0826-4B incorporates a broader patient population and richer clinical event representations, while generally matching or exceeding Curiosity-0226-1B, the largest model in the previous Curiosity-0226 series, on evaluated tasks supported by both models. Laboratory value prediction improved, with MAE 18--46% lower than that of Curiosity-0226-1B. We evaluated prediction of disease events across pediatric cohorts aged 2--17 years. AUROCs for new asthma diagnosis (0.742--0.785) and asthma exacerbation (0.829--0.852) were comparable to those in the adult reference cohort, while AUROCs for sickle cell crisis (0.820--0.847) were lower than in adults (0.915). Explicit representation of documented death enabled new mortality prediction tasks among adults across hospice, inpatient, and ambulatory settings (AUROC 0.821--0.942). Scaling-law analysis guided compute-optimal initial pretraining followed by continued pretraining with context extension. The resulting Curiosity-0826-4B model has more parameters (4.3B versus 1B) and a longer context window (16K versus 8K). It processes 56% fewer training tokens and requires 2.2 times the training floating point operations (FLOPs) compared with its predecessor. By extending a common zero-shot prediction strategy to pediatric patients and additional outcomes, Curiosity-0826-4B broadens opportunities to develop clinical and operational applications without training separate task-specific models. Further validation should assess local calibration, performance across patient subgroups and event frequencies, timeline completion rates, and generalization to new settings, alongside prospective evaluation of clinical and operational utility.
zh_abstract: 我们介绍 Curiosity-0826-4B，这是生成式医学事件基础模型（generative medical event foundation model）的更新版本，在 Epic Cosmos 上训练，通过模拟患者时间线来产生零样本临床预测。Curiosity-0826-4B 纳入了更广泛的患者人群和更丰富的临床事件表示，并在两个模型均支持的评估任务上总体达到或超过上一代 Curiosity-0226 系列中最大的模型 Curiosity-0226-1B。实验室值预测得到改善，MAE 较 Curiosity-0226-1B 低 18–46%。我们评估了 2–17 岁儿科队列中疾病事件的预测。新发哮喘诊断的 AUROC（0.742–0.785）和哮喘急性发作的 AUROC（0.829–0.852）与成人参考队列相当，而镰状细胞危象的 AUROC（0.820–0.847）低于成人（0.915）。对已记录死亡的显式表示使得能够在成人中开展新的死亡预测任务，涵盖临终关怀、住院和门诊环境（AUROC 0.821–0.942）。缩放定律分析指导了计算最优的初始预训练，随后进行带上下文扩展的持续预训练。所得的 Curiosity-0826-4B 模型具有更多参数（4.3B 对 1B）和更长上下文窗口（16K 对 8K）。与其前代相比，它处理的训练 token 少 56%，需要 2.2 倍的训练浮点运算（FLOPs）。通过将常见的零样本预测策略扩展到儿科患者和更多结局，Curiosity-0826-4B 拓宽了无需训练单独任务特定模型即可开发临床和运营应用的机会。进一步验证应评估本地校准、跨患者亚组和事件频率的性能、时间线完成率以及对新环境的泛化能力，并同时开展临床和运营效用的前瞻性评估。

title: NIBench: benchmarking autonomous AI agents for execution, skill evolution and scientific judgment in neuroimaging
zh_title: NIBench：神经影像自主AI智能体基准
summary: 预印本发布神经影像基准，从工作流重建、技能习得与科学判断三方面评测自主AI智能体。
key_points: 56项任务覆盖7个工具生态与多模态影像
涵盖结构、弥散、功能MRI与PET
关注输出合理但隐藏错误的风险
reason: 新公开基准切中智能体可靠性痛点，但为预印本、证据仍有限
abstract: Autonomous AI agents are increasingly used to automate biomedical research, creating a growing need to benchmark their capabilities on real scientific data and workflows. Their reliability in neuroimaging remains insufficiently characterized, where plausible analytical outputs can conceal errors that affect scientific conclusions. Existing studies have advanced scientific question answering and tool-based automation, but provide limited evidence on workflow reconstruction, acquisition of procedural expertise and evidence-based scientific judgment. Here we present NIBench, a neuroimaging benchmark comprising three complementary evaluations of autonomous agents. First, we benchmark execution and workflow reconstruction using 56 tasks across seven tool ecosystems, covering structural, diffusion and functional magnetic resonance imaging, positron emission tomography and multimodal analyses. Second, we examine whether agents can evolve their procedural skills through distillation of execution trajectories, evaluating the resulting skills on previously encountered tasks, unseen tasks and other models. Third, we assess scientific judgment using 36 claims from published Alzheimer's disease studies, requiring agents to analyse raw cohort data and provide reproducible evidence. We evaluate 19 language models within a shared agent framework, with selected models undergoing skill distillation and claim evaluation. Leading agents execute supplied analysis protocols nearly perfectly, whereas withholding procedural guidance widens performance differences. Distilled skills improve performance on acquisition tasks and transfer between models, but benefits on unseen tasks are inconsistent. Agents reproduce their reported results yet sometimes reach conclusions inconsistent with expert-derived answers, and access to data does not always improve judgment.
zh_abstract: 自主AI智能体（AI agents）正越来越多地用于自动化生物医学研究，这使得在真实科学数据和工作流程上对其能力进行基准测试的需求日益增长。它们在神经影像学中的可靠性仍未得到充分表征，在该领域，看似合理的分析输出可能掩盖影响科学结论的错误。现有研究推进了科学问答和基于工具的自动化，但在工作流程重建、程序性专长的获取以及基于证据的科学判断方面提供的证据有限。在此，我们提出NIBench，一个神经影像学基准，包含对自主智能体的三项互补评估。第一，我们使用跨越七个工具生态系统的56项任务对执行和工作流程重建进行基准测试，涵盖结构性、弥散性和功能性磁共振成像、正电子发射断层扫描以及多模态分析。第二，我们考察智能体能否通过蒸馏执行轨迹来演化其程序性技能，并在先前遇到的任务、未见任务和其他模型上评估所得技能。第三，我们使用来自已发表阿尔茨海默病研究的36项论断评估科学判断，要求智能体分析原始队列数据并提供可重复证据。我们在一个共享智能体框架内评估19个语言模型，并对选定模型进行技能蒸馏和论断评估。领先的智能体几乎完美地执行所提供的分析方案，而不提供程序性指导会扩大性能差异。蒸馏技能提高了在习得任务上的性能，并可在模型间迁移，但在未见任务上的收益不一致。智能体能复现其报告的结果，但有时得出与专家推导答案不一致的结论，而且获取数据并不总能改善判断。

title: Evaluating Pretrained Language Semantics for Structured EHR Prediction Tasks
zh_title: 预训练语言语义用于结构化电子病历预测任务
summary: 提出tEHR，将结构化EHR事件转为自然语言描述，做EHR自适应继续预训练与LoRA微调后用于纵向预测。
key_points: 以Mistral-7B作为纵向患者编码器
在MIMIC-IV四个任务与CPRD胰腺癌预测上评估
预测时间跨度为1至12个月
reason: 预印本新方法，多数据集多任务评估，但证据有限
abstract: Structured Electronic Health Records (EHR) models typically treat each clinical concept as a dataset-specific token, discarding the natural-language semantics associated with the event. As a result, relationships between concepts must largely be learned from EHR co-occurrence, without directly exploiting any prior semantic knowledge. We investigate how pretrained causal language models can be adapted for longitudinal EHR prediction by developing tEHR. Here, we represent events with their natural language description and use this text stream to apply EHR-adaptive continued pretraining, followed by task-specific discriminative fine-tuning using LoRA, utilising the LLM as a longitudinal patient-encoder. We evaluate this approach across four prediction tasks on the MIMIC-IV dataset and pancreatic cancer prediction on the CPRD dataset at 1 to 12 month horizons, with tEHR using the Mistral-7B-v0.3 backbone achieving the strongest overall performance. Ablations show that performance declines when clinical descriptions are removed or misaligned, when numerical values are omitted, and when either stage of adaptation is removed, while explicit elapsed-time descriptions provide little additional benefit. Analysis of the learned patient representations further reveals clinically coherent structure associated with distinct patterns of disease risk and clinical history.
zh_abstract: 结构化电子健康记录（Electronic Health Records，EHR）模型通常将每个临床概念视为数据集特定的标记，丢弃与该事件相关的自然语言语义。因此，概念之间的关系必须在很大程度上从EHR共现中学习，而无法直接利用任何先验语义知识。我们通过开发tEHR，研究如何将预训练因果语言模型适配用于纵向EHR预测。在此，我们用事件的自然语言描述来表示事件，并利用该文本流进行EHR自适应继续预训练，随后使用LoRA进行任务特定的判别式微调，将LLM用作纵向患者编码器。我们在MIMIC-IV数据集上的四项预测任务以及CPRD数据集上的胰腺癌预测中，在1至12个月的预测时程上评估了该方法，其中使用Mistral-7B-v0.3主干的tEHR取得最强的总体性能。消融实验表明，当临床描述被移除或错位、当数值被省略、以及当任一适应阶段被移除时，性能会下降，而显式经过时间描述几乎不提供额外获益。对所学患者表征的分析进一步揭示了与不同疾病风险和临床病史模式相关的临床连贯结构。

title: Do Rule-Derived Labels Improve Prediction When Reported Labels Are Limited? A Two-Site Machine Learning Study
zh_title: 规则衍生弱标签能否提升预测：双中心机器学习研究
summary: 在两家机构EHR尿培养数据上做标签预算实验，评估加入规则衍生弱标签对大肠埃希菌耐药预测的影响。
key_points: 数据来自Stanford ARMD与UT Southwestern ARMD-UTSW
预测头孢吡肟、头孢西丁、头孢他啶非敏感
报告标签预算取10%、25%、50%、100%并做五折患者不重叠划分
reason: 双中心探索性实验，预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: **Background.** Rule derived (weak) labels can enlarge a training set when reported labels are scarce. Their value depends on label quality, on how the extra records shift the training distribution, and on whether the comparison accounts for reported labels set aside for tuning or calibration. **Methods.** We ran an exploratory label-budget experiment on *Escherichia coli* urine cultures from two de-identified electronic health record datasets: Stanford ARMD and UT Southwestern ARMD-UTSW. The task was to predict reported non-susceptibility to cefepime, cefoxitin and ceftazidime (Stanford) and to cefepime and ceftazidime (UT Southwestern). Reported-label budgets of 10%, 25%, 50% and 100% of development patients were drawn over five patient-disjoint outer splits. Logistic regression and histogram gradient boosting were trained with reported labels only, or with added rule-derived labels using equal weights, a tuning-selected weight, class-proportion adjustment or prior-probability correction. These were compared with an all-budget reported-only baseline that used every budgeted reported label for training. Stanford used the inferred labels released with the dataset and a feature set including resistance history. UT Southwestern used researcher-derived labels from Stanford rule text, which were not validated for that site, and an age-only primary model. Brier-score differences were assessed with paired patient-cluster bootstrap intervals. **Results.** All rule-derived labels were susceptible. Equal-weight augmentation lowered mean predicted risk well below observed prevalence (for example, Stanford cefepime at the 10% budget: 0.35% versus 4.85%) and had a higher Brier score than the all-budget baseline in every drug, model and budget summary. The tuning-selected weight did not consistently improve on the all-budget baseline. Its median Brier difference was positive in 38 of 40 drug, model and budget summaries. Its paired intervals lay above zero in 100 of 296 Stanford analyses and 31 of 198 UT Southwestern analyses, and below zero in 3 and 5. The tuning set often selected a weight of zero (146 of 296 and 153 of 198 analyses). At UT Southwestern, the age-only models showed little discrimination (median AUROC 0.49 to 0.54), so those comparisons mainly reflect calibration. **Conclusions.** Under these designs, rule-derived labels did not consistently improve probability prediction over a reported-only model that used the whole reported-label budget for training.
zh_abstract: 【背景】当报告标签稀缺时，规则衍生（弱）标签可以扩大训练集。其价值取决于标签质量、额外记录如何改变训练分布，以及比较时是否考虑了留作调参或校准的报告标签。【方法】我们在来自两个去标识化电子健康记录数据集（Stanford ARMD 和 UT Southwestern ARMD-UTSW）的大肠埃希菌（Escherichia coli）尿液培养上开展了一项探索性标签预算实验。任务是预测对头孢吡肟、头孢西丁和头孢他啶（Stanford）以及对头孢吡肟和头孢他啶（UT Southwestern）报告的非敏感性。在五个患者不重叠的外层划分中，抽取了占开发集患者 10%、25%、50% 和 100% 的报告标签预算。逻辑回归和直方图梯度提升分别用仅报告标签，或加入规则衍生标签进行训练，后者采用等权重、调参选择的权重、类别比例调整或先验概率校正。将这些模型与全预算仅报告标签基线进行比较，该基线使用所有预算内报告标签进行训练。Stanford 使用随数据集发布的推断标签和包含耐药史的特征集。UT Southwestern 使用根据 Stanford 规则文本由研究者衍生的标签（未在该站点验证）以及一个仅含年龄的主模型。Brier 评分差异采用配对患者簇 bootstrap 区间评估。【结果】所有规则衍生标签均为敏感。等权重增强使平均预测风险远低于观察到的患病率（例如，Stanford 头孢吡肟在 10% 预算下：0.35% 对 4.85%），并且在每种药物、模型和预算汇总中，其 Brier 评分均高于全预算基线。调参选择的权重并未持续优于全预算基线。在 40 个药物、模型和预算汇总中，有 38 个的中位 Brier 差异为正值。其配对区间在 296 项 Stanford 分析中的 100 项和 198 项 UT Southwestern 分析中的 31 项高于零，并分别在 3 项和 5 项中低于零。调参集经常选择权重为零（296 项分析中的 146 项和 198 项分析中的 153 项）。在 UT Southwestern，仅年龄模型判别力很低（中位 AUROC 0.49 至 0.54），因此这些比较主要反映校准。【结论】在这些设计下，规则衍生标签并未持续优于使用全部报告标签预算进行训练的仅报告标签模型来改善概率预测。

title: Bloom unifies brain cell representations across modalities and contexts
zh_title: Bloom：跨模态统一脑细胞表征的Transformer模型
summary: 发布基于Transformer的Bloom模型，用基因表达、染色质可及性或两者表征脑细胞，在多项任务上优于单模态模型。
key_points: 训练于30万成年小鼠脑细胞配对测量数据
用序列嵌入结合随机多模态细胞视图
在细胞类型解析、注释与标签迁移任务上表现更优
reason: 预印本细胞基础模型，有基线对比但规模与验证有限
abstract: Multimodal genomic datasets now profile mammalian brain cells across anatomical regions, developmental stages, disease states, and species. Learning shared representations that capture cellular diversity across these heterogeneous observations remains a central challenge. Here, we introduce Bloom, a transformer-based model that represents cells using gene expression, chromatin accessibility, or both. Bloom is trained on 300,000 adult mouse brain cells with paired measurements, randomly sampled with broad-subclass balancing--approximately 100-fold fewer cells than used by comparable pre-trained models. By combining genomic sequence embeddings with randomly sampled multimodal cell views, Bloom outperforms unimodal cell models in resolving brain-wide cell types and in annotation, regression, and label-transfer tasks. Its attention patterns reveal cell-type-dependent associations among genomic loci, including pairs separated by millions of base pairs. These results establish Bloom as a data-efficient framework for integrating multimodal brain cell measurements and generating hypotheses about cell-type-specific genomic relationships.
zh_abstract: 多模态基因组数据集如今可对哺乳动物脑细胞进行跨解剖区域、发育阶段、疾病状态和物种的分析。学习能够捕捉这些异质观察中细胞多样性的共享表征仍是一项核心挑战。在此，我们介绍 Bloom，一种基于 transformer 的模型，可利用基因表达、染色质可及性或两者来表示细胞。Bloom 在 300,000 个具有配对测量的成年小鼠脑细胞上训练，采用广泛亚类平衡的随机抽样——所用细胞数量比可比预训练模型约少 100 倍。通过将基因组序列嵌入与随机抽样的多模态细胞视图相结合，Bloom 在全脑细胞类型解析以及注释、回归和标签迁移任务中优于单模态细胞模型。其注意力模式揭示了基因组位点之间细胞类型依赖的关联，包括相隔数百万碱基对的位点对。这些结果确立了 Bloom 作为一个数据高效框架，用于整合多模态脑细胞测量并生成关于细胞类型特异性基因组关系的假设。

title: Enrollees and Early Lessons from an Agentic Healthcare Platform with Physicians in the Loop
zh_title: 医师在环的智能体医疗平台用户特征分析
summary: 预印本描述Lotus AI平台3223名完成注册用户的人口学与疾病负担特征，并与全国基准比较。
key_points: 纳入3223名有健康档案的注册用户
各年龄段慢病患病率高于全国调查4–7个百分点
功能性疾病用户触发更多医师升级与人工投入
reason: 有规模的描述性用户分析，无对照与结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Agentic healthcare platforms that combine large language models with physician oversight are growing quickly, but little is known about who uses them. We characterized 3,223 enrollees of Lotus AI, a free, physician-supervised agentic platform, who completed onboarding, messaged the agent, and had a linked health record between February and July 2026, and compared them with national benchmarks. Median age was 51 years and 62% were male. Chronic condition prevalence exceeded 2024 National Health Interview Survey estimates in every age band by 4 to 7 percentage points; 18% had a functional or symptom-defined disorder; among the 30% with four or more ambulatory visits in the prior year, care was spread across nearly five providers, with 44% meeting a threshold for high fragmentation. Users with functional disorders generated 1.8 times as many physician escalations and 2.6 times as many laboratory orders as other users, but no more prescriptions. This profile differs from the younger, predominantly female populations reported for direct-to-consumer telemedicine. It moves chronic disease management, functional disorder pathways, and care coordination from aspirations to design requirements, and we argue that deployed AI care platforms should characterize their populations against national benchmarks early.
zh_abstract: 将大语言模型与医生监督相结合的智能体医疗保健平台正在快速增长，但人们对其使用者是谁知之甚少。我们对Lotus AI的3,223名入组者进行了特征描述，并将其与国家基准进行比较；Lotus AI是一个免费的、由医生监督的智能体平台，这些入组者在2026年2月至7月间完成了注册流程、向智能体发送了消息并拥有关联的健康记录。中位年龄为51岁，62%为男性。各年龄段慢性病患病率均超过2024年全国健康访谈调查（National Health Interview Survey）估计值4至7个百分点；18%患有功能性或症状定义的疾病；在上一年有四次或以上门诊就诊的30%人群中，照护分散在近五名提供者之间，44%达到高度碎片化阈值。患有功能性疾病的使用者产生的医生升级处理次数是其他使用者的1.8倍，实验室检查医嘱是其他使用者的2.6倍，但处方并不更多。这一特征不同于直接面向消费者远程医疗所报告的更年轻、以女性为主的人群。它将慢性病管理、功能性疾病路径和照护协调从愿景转变为设计要求，并且我们认为，已部署的AI照护平台应尽早参照国家基准刻画其人群特征。

title: Unsupervised Deep Learning for Cryo-EM/ET Particle Classification
zh_title: 无监督深度学习用于冷冻电镜颗粒分类
summary: 预印本提出基于自编码器的无监督框架，联合优化姿态与结构，分类冷冻电镜与电子断层颗粒图像。
key_points: 自编码器多阶段流程联合优化姿态与结构
可捕捉颗粒视角连续变化并剔除污染
在模拟混合蛋白数据上验证分离能力
reason: 结构生物学方法预印本，验证限于模拟数据，证据有限
abstract: Cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) is widely used to determine protein structures from purified samples. With cryogenic electron tomography (cryo-ET), it is possible to image thin sections of cells and directly visualize diverse proteins in their native environment. However, separating the massive mixture of different types of proteins inside cells remains challenging, especially without human intervention. In this work, we present an unsupervised deep learning framework for classifying cryo-EM/ET particle images that jointly optimizes for pose and structure through an autoencoder-based multi-stage pipeline. On single-particle cryo-EM datasets, our framework can capture the continuous variation in particle views and separate images of real particles from contamination. Using in silico mixtures of multiple types of proteins, we demonstrated our method's capability of separating the protein classes without supervision. Finally in a real cryo-ET dataset of algal chloroplast, our deep learning model successfully detected the four main protein complexes of photosynthesis on native thylakoid membranes. Taken together, these results demonstrate that our framework offers a scalable, annotation-free solution for robust structural discovery across diverse cryo-EM and cryo-ET applications.
zh_abstract: 冷冻电子显微镜（cryogenic electron microscopy, cryo-EM）被广泛用于从纯化样品中解析蛋白质结构。借助冷冻电子断层扫描（cryogenic electron tomography, cryo-ET），可以对细胞薄切片成像，并直接可视化其天然环境中的多种蛋白质。然而，在细胞内大量不同类型蛋白质的混合物中进行分离仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在没有人工干预的情况下。在本工作中，我们提出了一个无监督深度学习框架，用于对冷冻电镜/电子断层扫描颗粒图像进行分类，该框架通过基于自编码器的多阶段流程联合优化位姿和结构。在单颗粒冷冻电镜数据集上，我们的框架能够捕捉颗粒视角的连续变化，并将真实颗粒图像与污染图像区分开。使用多种类型蛋白质的计算机模拟混合物，我们证明了该方法能够在无监督情况下分离蛋白质类别。最后，在一个藻类叶绿体的真实冷冻电子断层扫描数据集中，我们的深度学习模型成功检测到了天然类囊体膜上光合作用的四个主要蛋白质复合物。综上所述，这些结果表明，我们的框架为多种冷冻电镜和冷冻电子断层扫描应用中的稳健结构发现提供了一种可扩展、无需标注的解决方案。

title: HieraPTM: From PTM Site Recognition to Functional Phosphosite Prediction through Hierarchical Context and Protein Mechanics
zh_title: HieraPTM：从PTM位点识别到功能磷酸化位点预测
summary: 预印本提出跨任务分层框架，联合蛋白质翻译后修饰位点识别与功能磷酸化位点预测。
key_points: 融合局部序列、蛋白语言模型与三维结构
HieraFuncPhos迁移识别表征并检索力学证据
预印本，摘要未给出量化评测结果
reason: 预印本新方法，跨任务设计有新意，但证据仅限摘要，属值得一看档
abstract: Protein post-translational modifications (PTMs) regulate cellular signaling and protein function, making accurate site identification essential for understanding protein regulation. However, PTM site recognition and functional phosphosite prediction are largely modeled independently, limiting the transfer of large-scale recognition knowledge to functional prioritization. Here, we introduce HieraPTM-HieraFuncPhos, a cross-task hierarchical framework that separately models and conditionally integrates transferable PTM recognition representations and function-specific mechanical evidence. HieraPTM integrates local sequence patterns, protein language model representations, and three-dimensional structural information to recognize multiple PTM types. HieraFuncPhos transfers these representations through parameter-efficient adaptation and adaptively retrieves local and distal mechanical evidence conditioned on functional representations. At HSP90AA1 T36 and T115, the model reveals distinct mechanical response patterns consistent with published nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) observations, suggesting that the framework not only prioritizes functional phosphosites but also provides biophysically grounded, testable hypotheses regarding site-specific regulation. HieraPTM achieved macro-averaged AUROC and AUPRC values of 0.9237 and 0.8425 across eight PTM tasks, while maintaining competitive performance on severely imbalanced external benchmarks. HieraFuncPhos achieved an AUROC of 0.8274 and an AUPRC of 0.8188, outperforming existing comparison methods. Together, this framework connects PTM site recognition, functional prioritization, and structure-informed hypotheses regarding potential regulatory processes.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质翻译后修饰（PTM）调控细胞信号传导和蛋白质功能，因此准确识别修饰位点对于理解蛋白质调控至关重要。然而，PTM 位点识别和功能性磷酸化位点预测在很大程度上被独立建模，限制了将大规模识别知识迁移到功能优先级排序。在此，我们提出 HieraPTM-HieraFuncPhos，这是一个跨任务分层框架，分别建模并条件整合可迁移的 PTM 识别表征和功能特异性的力学证据。HieraPTM 整合局部序列模式、蛋白质语言模型表征和三维结构信息，以识别多种 PTM 类型。HieraFuncPhos 通过参数高效适配迁移这些表征，并以功能表征为条件自适应检索局部和远端力学证据。在 HSP90AA1 T36 和 T115 位点，该模型揭示了与已发表核磁共振（NMR）观察结果一致的不同力学响应模式，提示该框架不仅优先排序功能性磷酸化位点，还就位点特异性调控提供具有生物物理依据、可检验的假设。HieraPTM 在八项 PTM 任务上取得宏平均 AUROC 和 AUPRC 分别为 0.9237 和 0.8425，同时在严重不平衡的外部基准上保持有竞争力的性能。HieraFuncPhos 取得 AUROC 0.8274 和 AUPRC 0.8188，优于现有对比方法。总体而言，该框架将 PTM 位点识别、功能优先级排序以及关于潜在调控过程的结构信息假设联系起来。

title: BenchmarkHub: an open-source platform for reproducible evaluation of large language models in healthcare
zh_title: BenchmarkHub：医疗大模型可复现评测开源平台
summary: 预印本发布MIT许可开源平台，固定种子采样并记录提示与推理设置以实现可审计评测。
key_points: 支持浏览器、命令行与REST API
固定种子采样，确定性规则评分
存储全部提示与推理记录
代码已在GitHub公开
reason: 开源评测工具，针对可复现性痛点，但为预印本且证据有限
abstract: Background: Large language models (LLMs) are solely judged by their scores on biomedical benchmarks, yet these scores are rarely reproducible since the prompts, inference settings and model builds are seldom reported. We developed BenchmarkHub, an open-source platform for auditable evaluation of language and vision-language models for biomedical research. Methods: BenchmarkHub is a Python web application (Django 5.2, SQLite) released under the MIT licence and available at https://github.com/juanjuanignacio/benchmarkhub. The application can be accessed through a browser interface, a set of command-line tools and a REST API, so interactive exploration and scripted pipelines produce identical, comparable records. The platform samples questions with fixed seeds, runs models directly or as tool-using agents in a code sandbox, grades answers with deterministic rules and stores every prompt, reply and tool call. The interface provides a leaderboard to rank performance of the models, allowing model comparison without any preexisting programming knowledge. Findings: We used BenchmarkHub to evaluate 12 open-weight models in five experiments on 15 biomedical benchmarks (11 text, two multimodal and two computational biology) and two general benchmarks. The pooled accuracy ranged from 46.1% (95% CI 43.0-49.3) to 80.9% (78.3-83.3). 【背景】大语言模型（LLMs）仅通过其在生物医学基准上的得分来评判，然而这些得分很少可复现，因为提示、推理设置和模型构建版本很少被报告。我们开发了 BenchmarkHub，一个用于生物医学研究语言模型和视觉语言模型可审计评估的开源平台。

【方法】BenchmarkHub 是一个 Python Web 应用（Django 5.2、SQLite），以 MIT 许可证发布，可在 https://github.com/juanjuanignacio/benchmarkhub 获取。该应用可通过浏览器界面、一组命令行工具和 REST API 访问，因此交互式探索和脚本化流水线会产生相同、可比较的记录。平台以固定随机种子采样问题，直接运行模型或在代码沙箱中作为使用工具的智能体运行模型，用确定性规则给答案评分，并存储每个提示、回复和工具调用。界面提供排行榜对模型性能排名，使无需任何既有编程知识即可进行模型比较。

title: ModBERT: a DNA modification and genetic variant-aware DNA large language model

They therefore cannot represent the two sources of variation most directly tied to regulatory differences between people: genetic variants and DNA methylation. Long-read sequencing (Nanopore and PacBio) now measures both from the same native DNA molecules, but no model is designed to use this joint readout. With this in mind, we developed ModBERT, a DNA language model built on a five-letter probabilistic genome representation in which each position is a distribution over A, C, G, T, 5mC (represented with M). title: Affinity-guided design of PDZ-binding peptides in a shared latent space
zh_title: 潜空间中的PDZ结合肽亲和力设计
summary: 预印本提出基于PDZ-PBM共享潜空间的深度学习方法，按单靶点、脱靶感知与双靶点目标设计肽序列。
key_points: 学习PDZ-PBM共享潜空间
可导向单靶点与脱靶感知设计
基于定量亲和力预测模型
reason: 有新方法设计思路的预印本，证据限于计算评估
abstract: PDZ-binding motifs (PBMs) are short C-terminal sequences that bind PDZ domains and contribute to protein localization and complex assembly. Designing PBMs could modulate these interactions while leaving most of the original protein sequence unchanged. Because PDZ recognition preferences overlap, modulating intended interactions requires considering off-target binding alongside target affinity. Computational PBM design methods generally use sequence-based affinity prediction and structure-based evaluation, but it remains challenging to guide sequence searches toward different binding objectives with a single trained model. Here, we propose a deep learning-based method to design PBMs by analytically formulating single-target, off-target-aware, and dual-target design objectives as directions in a PDZ-PBM shared latent space learned through quantitative PDZ-PBM affinity prediction. In single-target PBM redesign for DLG4-PDZ3, our method identified 100 top-ranked candidates, 84 of which were in the top 1% for experimentally measured interaction fitness in a published mutant library, compared with 64 using an existing method. In single-target de novo design of 10-residue PBMs, our method achieved the highest median in silico binding scores among the compared methods for three of the four PDZ domains tested. In off-target-aware and dual-target PBM design for PTPN3 and SCRIB-PDZ3, off-target-aware design increased between-group score differences within each domain at the cost of lower target-domain scores, whereas dual-target design yielded scores close to those of the respective single-target designs for both domains. Together, these results show that shared latent representations learned from quantitative affinities allow a single trained model to guide PBM design across different binding objectives without retraining.
zh_abstract: PDZ 结合基序（PDZ-binding motifs, PBMs）是短的 C 端序列，可结合 PDZ 结构域并参与蛋白质定位和复合物组装。设计 PBM 可在保持原始蛋白序列大部分不变的同时调节这些相互作用。由于 PDZ 识别偏好存在重叠，调节预期相互作用需要考虑脱靶结合以及靶标亲和力。计算 PBM 设计方法通常使用基于序列的亲和力预测和基于结构的评估，但用单一训练模型引导序列搜索朝向不同结合目标仍具挑战性。在此，我们提出一种基于深度学习的方法来设计 PBM，通过解析方式将单靶标、脱靶感知和双靶标设计目标表述为通过定量 PDZ-PBM 亲和力预测学习到的 PDZ-PBM 共享潜在空间中的方向。在针对 DLG4-PDZ3 的单靶标 PBM 重设计中，我们的方法识别出 100 个排名最高的候选物，其中 84 个在已发表突变体库中实验测量的相互作用适应度中位于前 1%，而使用现有方法为 64 个。在 10 个残基 PBM 的单靶标从头设计中，对于所测试的四个 PDZ 结构域中的三个，我们的方法在比较方法中获得了最高的计算机模拟（in silico）结合评分中位数。在针对 PTPN3 和 SCRIB-PDZ3 的脱靶感知和双靶标 PBM 设计中，脱靶感知设计以较低靶结构域评分为代价增加了每个结构域内的组间评分差异，而双靶标设计对两个结构域产生的评分接近各自单靶标设计的评分。总之，这些结果表明，从定量亲和力学习到的共享潜在表示可使单一训练模型无需重新训练即可指导跨不同结合目标的 PBM 设计。

title: Support-Constrained Offline Policy Improvement for Pediatric ECMO from Limited Clinical Data
zh_title: 儿科ECMO的支撑约束离线策略改进
summary: 提出FQI-SC离线强化学习框架，在数据支撑不足处回退到临床医生行为，用78条儿科ECMO轨迹评估。
key_points: 限制优化在经验支持的状態-动作对
低数据区域默认采用临床医生基线
78条轨迹、超6000小时数据，仅离线评估
reason: 有新意的离线RL方法但仅78例单数据集，无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Managing children on ECMO (Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation) requires balancing short-term physiological stability with the long-term goal of preventing neurological injury. Standard reinforcement learning can propose risky, out-of-distribution actions, while imitation learning is limited to reproducing clinician behavior. We introduce Support-Constrained Fitted Q-Iteration (FQI-SC), an offline reinforcement learning framework that cautiously improves upon expert behavior by restricting optimization to empirically supported state-action pairs and defaulting to the clinician baseline in low-data regions. On 78 pediatric trajectories totaling over 6,000 hours of clinical data, we evaluate our framework using Fitted Q-Evaluation (FQE) and a behavioral disagreement. Additionally, we formalize the performance-safety trade-off by introducing a unified Balance Score ($S(π)$). Our empirical evaluation shows that support-constrained policy improves the Balance Score by 38\% relative to FQI, improves estimated value by 1.28 FQE units over imitation learning, and reduces disagreement with clinician actions by 71\% relative to FQI.
zh_abstract: 管理接受ECMO（体外膜肺氧合）的儿童需要平衡短期生理稳定与预防神经损伤的长期目标。标准强化学习可能提出有风险、分布外的动作，而模仿学习仅限于复现临床医生行为。我们引入支持约束拟合Q迭代（Support-Constrained Fitted Q-Iteration, FQI-SC），这是一种离线强化学习框架，通过将优化限制在经验支持的状态-动作对上，并在低数据区域默认采用临床医生基线，谨慎地改进专家行为。在78条儿科轨迹、总计超过6,000小时的临床数据上，我们使用拟合Q评估（Fitted Q-Evaluation, FQE）和行为不一致性来评估我们的框架。此外，我们通过引入统一的Balance Score（$S(π)$）来形式化性能-安全权衡。我们的实证评估显示，支持约束策略使Balance Score相对FQI提高38%，估计值较模仿学习提高1.28个FQE单位，并将与临床医生动作的不一致性相对FQI降低71%。

title: Your Vision Foundation Model Is Secretly an EEG Foundation Model
zh_title: 视觉基础模型可作冻结EEG编码器
summary: 将EEG按通道渲染为图像输入冻结视觉Transformer，仅学显示参数，迁移表现优于专用EEG基础模型。
key_points: 冻结视觉主干，只学习EEG显示方式
每通道独立行，波形或时频图二选一
报告专用EEG模型的冻结特征迁移更差
reason: 结论有反直觉新意且含基线对比，但仍为预印本、缺临床外部验证
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are pretrained on thousands of hours of recordings, yet their frozen features transfer poorly to downstream tasks, and this transfer does not consistently improve with larger models or more pretraining data. We show that a vision foundation model that has never seen EEG is a stronger frozen EEG encoder than these specialized models, once the signals are rendered as images that a vision transformer can read. Our method, SeeEEG, keeps the vision backbone frozen and learns only how EEG is displayed to it. Each channel occupies a dedicated row of patches and is drawn either as a waveform at a fixed gain or as a scalogram whose frequency range spans the patch height, so that task-relevant patterns fall within individual tokens. The montage, filtering, and contrast parameters of this display are initialized from a standard clinical montage and optimized with the task loss through the frozen backbone, which amounts to at most 1,113 trainable parameters per view. We compare SeeEEG with seven EEG foundation models on eight clinical, sleep, affective, and brain-computer interface datasets, with every encoder frozen and paired with identical readout heads. With a frozen DINOv3 ViT-B, SeeEEG outperforms every EEG foundation model in balanced accuracy on all eight datasets and reaches a mean rank of 1.3 in Cohen kappa or AUROC, compared with 2.9 for the strongest baseline, REVE. The learned displays transfer without further optimization to the video encoder V-JEPA 2.1, which outperforms every EEG foundation model on both metrics on six of the eight datasets. Replacing DINOv3 with a randomly initialized ViT-B lowers the score by 15.2 points on average, so the ability to read rendered EEG comes from visual pretraining.
zh_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）基础模型在数千小时的记录上预训练，然而其冻结特征向下游任务迁移效果差，且这种迁移并不随模型更大或预训练数据更多而持续改善。我们表明，一个从未见过 EEG 的视觉基础模型，在将信号渲染为视觉 Transformer 可读取的图像后，是比这些专用模型更强的冻结 EEG 编码器。我们的方法 SeeEEG 保持视觉主干冻结，仅学习如何向它显示 EEG。每个通道占据专门的一行图块，并绘制为固定增益的波形，或绘制为频率范围跨越图块高度的尺度图，从而使任务相关模式落在单个 token 内。该显示的蒙太奇（montage）、滤波和对比度参数从标准临床蒙太奇初始化，并通过冻结主干用任务损失优化，每个视图最多仅有 1,113 个可训练参数。我们在八个临床、睡眠、情感和脑机接口数据集上，将 SeeEEG 与七个 EEG 基础模型比较，所有编码器均冻结并配以相同的读出头。在冻结的 DINOv3 ViT-B 下，SeeEEG 在所有八个数据集上的平衡准确率均优于每个 EEG 基础模型，并在 Cohen kappa 或 AUROC 上达到平均排名 1.3，而最强基线 REVE 为 2.9。学到的显示无需进一步优化即可迁移到视频编码器 V-JEPA 2.1，该编码器在八个数据集中的六个上，在这两项指标上均优于每个 EEG 基础模型。将 DINOv3 替换为随机初始化的 ViT-B 会使分数平均降低 15.2 分，因此读取渲染 EEG 的能力来自视觉预训练。

title: PDO Drug Screening Data for Evaluating and Training AI Drug Response Prediction Models
zh_title: 类器官药敏数据用于训练与评估AI药效预测
summary: 预印本用四项患者来源类器官药敏研究产生多组学与反应数据，重训并评估公开药物反应预测模型。
key_points: 患者来源类器官替代永生化细胞系
提供多组学谱、药物特征与反应数据
在多种设定下重训评估公开DRP模型
reason: 方法有新意且涉及数据资源，但为预印本、评估范围有限
abstract: Anti-cancer drug response prediction (DRP) is critically important for precision oncology and therapeutic development. Currently, most DRP models are developed using drug screening data from immortalized cancer cell lines, which can differ substantially from patient tumors at the genomic and molecular levels, even though patient tumor response is the ultimate prediction target. To help bridge this gap and bring DRP models closer to their intended clinical application, we conducted four drug screening studies using patient-derived organoids (PDOs), which more faithfully recapitulate patient tumors than immortalized cell lines. These studies generated data for improving and evaluating DRP models, including multi-omics profiles of PDO lines, drug feature data, and treatment response measurements. Using these data, we retrained and evaluated multiple publicly available DRP models under three model-building scenarios: training models using cell line data only, training models using combined cell line and PDO data, and pretraining models on cell line data followed by fine-tuning on PDO data. We then evaluated and compared model prediction performance on PDOs across these analysis scenarios. In addition, we also assessed the consistency of drug screening viability data generated by different laboratories using different assay technologies and/or experimental protocols.
zh_abstract: 抗癌药物反应预测（DRP）对精准肿瘤学和治疗开发至关重要。目前，大多数DRP模型是利用永生化癌细胞系的药物筛选数据开发的，尽管患者肿瘤反应是最终的预测目标，但永生化癌细胞系在基因组和分子水平上可能与患者肿瘤存在显著差异。为帮助弥合这一差距并使DRP模型更接近其预期临床应用，我们使用患者来源类器官（PDOs）开展了四项药物筛选研究；与永生化细胞系相比，PDOs能更忠实地再现患者肿瘤。这些研究产生了用于改进和评估DRP模型的数据，包括PDO系的多组学图谱、药物特征数据以及治疗反应测量数据。利用这些数据，我们在三种模型构建情景下重新训练并评估了多个公开可用的DRP模型：仅使用细胞系数据训练模型、使用细胞系与PDO联合数据训练模型，以及在细胞系数据上预训练模型随后在PDO数据上微调。随后，我们在这些分析情景中评估并比较了模型在PDOs上的预测性能。此外，我们还评估了不同实验室使用不同检测技术和/或实验方案所产生的药物筛选活力数据的一致性。

title: TransXplainRRG: A Radiologist-Evaluated LVLM for Chest Radiograph Report Generation
zh_title: TransXplainRRG：经放射科医生评估的胸片报告生成模型
summary: 预印本提出结合患者病史与异常征象提取的胸片报告生成框架，并由放射科医生进行可解释性评估。
key_points: 基于Swin Transformer并引入患者病史文本
采用专家引导的「由内而外」异常征象提炼
由放射科医生参与评估可解释性
reason: 有新方法与专家评估，但为未经同行评审预印本，证据有限
abstract: Recent advancements in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLM) enhance X-ray report generation, but often neglect clinical context, overlook workflow integration, and lack explainability, which hinders clinical adoption due to interpretability and reliability concerns. This paper addresses the dual challenges of performance and expert explainability in automated X-ray report generation for clinical AI applications. Our proposed approach, TransXplainRRG, utilises an off-the-shelf Swin Transformer model along with a transformer-based text encoder that incorporates patient medical history to generate a radiology report. Further, we explore an expert-guided `inside-out' approach and extract only abnormal findings for radiology report refinement. Thus, this study bridges the gap between high-performance automation and interpretability critical for clinical practice by combining state-of-the-art transformer-based vision encoders, text encoders, and LLMs. TransXplainRRG is trained and tested on the large-scale MIMIC-CXR dataset and further evaluated on the unseen IU X-Ray dataset to demonstrate its generalizability and robustness. We employed the GREEN metric as a complementary measure of clinical consistency, achieving scores of 0.327 on MIMIC-CXR and 0.605 on IU X-Ray, both higher than those achieved by MAIRA-2 under the same evaluation setting. It also performed competitively across standard evaluation metrics, frequently matching or surpassing state-of-the-art models. Additionally, we introduce qualitative evaluation metrics developed from radiologists' viewpoints and conduct a preliminary radiologist evaluation on 100 generated reports to assess their clinical relevance. Quantitative and qualitative analyses further demonstrate the potential of our TransXplainRRG framework for reliable and explainable radiology report generation.
zh_abstract: 近年来，大型视觉-语言模型（Large Vision-Language Models, LVLM）的进展提升了X线报告生成，但往往忽视临床背景、忽略工作流程整合，并缺乏可解释性；由于可解释性和可靠性方面的担忧，这阻碍了临床采用。本文针对临床人工智能应用中自动X线报告生成的性能与专家可解释性双重挑战展开研究。我们提出的方法TransXplainRRG利用现成的Swin Transformer模型以及一个融入患者病史、基于Transformer的文本编码器来生成放射学报告。进一步地，我们探索了一种专家引导的“inside-out”（由内而外）方法，仅提取异常发现用于放射学报告的精炼。因此，本研究通过结合最先进的基于Transformer的视觉编码器、文本编码器和LLM，弥合了高性能自动化与临床实践至关重要的可解释性之间的差距。TransXplainRRG在大规模MIMIC-CXR数据集上训练和测试，并在未见过的IU X-Ray数据集上进一步评估，以展示其泛化性和稳健性。我们采用GREEN指标作为临床一致性的补充度量，在MIMIC-CXR上获得0.327分，在IU X-Ray上获得0.605分，均高于MAIRA-2在相同评估设置下取得的分数。它在标准评估指标上也表现出竞争力，经常达到或超过最先进模型。此外，我们引入了从放射科医生视角开发的定性评估指标，并对100份生成报告进行了初步的放射科医生评估，以评估其临床相关性。定量和定性分析进一步证明了我们的TransXplainRRG框架在可靠且可解释的放射学报告生成方面的潜力。

title: A risk-aware individualized blood pressure target to avoid hypotension in surgery
zh_title: 术中低血压风险感知的个体化血压目标与用药选择
summary: 预印本提出在线方法，基于短时血压与去甲肾上腺素记录拟合模型，在风险约束下选择最低血压目标与剂量。
key_points: 用局部高斯近似传播未来血压不确定性
以MAP低于65mmHg概率上限为约束
4096例虚拟患者中74%给出推荐剂量
reason: 有新方法且回顾性数据评估校准，但为预印本、虚拟队列，无前瞻验证
abstract: We propose an online method for choosing both a blood pressure target and a norepinephrine dose for an individual surgical patient. From a short record of mean arterial pressure (MAP) and norepinephrine delivery, the method fits a reduced pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic model and uses a local Gaussian approximation to propagate uncertainty to future MAP readings. It searches for the lowest target for which a bolus and constant infusion keep the predicted probability of at least one MAP reading below 65 mmHg after the rise phase within a prescribed limit. If no such target is found, the decision returns to the clinician. We assess calibration of the predicted minimum MAP on retrospective surgical records under the doses actually administered. In a cohort of 4,096 virtual patients, the method recommended a dose for 74 % of patients at a nominal risk of 5 %. Among the patients receiving a recommendation, 6.9 % had a reading below 65 mmHg. A fixed target of 70 mmHg yielded a rate of 25 % when applied to the full virtual cohort.
zh_abstract: 我们提出一种在线方法，用于为个体手术患者同时选择血压目标和去甲肾上腺素剂量。根据平均动脉压（MAP）和去甲肾上腺素输注的短时记录，该方法拟合简化的药代动力学/药效学模型，并使用局部高斯近似将不确定性传播到未来MAP读数。它搜索最低目标，使得在上升期之后，一次推注和持续输注能将至少一次MAP读数低于65 mmHg的预测概率保持在规定限值以内。如果未找到这样的目标，决策返回给临床医生。我们在按实际给药剂量记录的回顾性手术记录上评估预测最低MAP的校准。在一个4,096名虚拟患者的队列中，该方法在名义风险为5%时为74%的患者推荐了剂量。在接受推荐的患者中，6.9%出现低于65 mmHg的读数。当应用于整个虚拟队列时，固定目标70 mmHg产生的发生率为25%。

title: Beyond Binary Classification: Multiclass Machine Learning for Diabetes and Prediabetes Risk Prediction Using NHANES
zh_title: 基于NHANES的多分类糖尿病风险预测
summary: 预印本用NHANES 15,356名成人数据构建正常、糖尿病前期、糖尿病三分类模型，比较传统机器学习与Transformer。
key_points: HbA1c仅用于定义标签，避免特征泄漏
另比较两种二分类建模方案
在留出测试集上评估精确率与F1等
reason: 公开数据、样本量较大且有基线对比，但为预印本且仅单数据集验证
abstract: Detecting diabetes risk early is important for preventing disease progression. Most existing machine learning approaches focus on binary classification, which limits their ability to capture intermediate risk states such as prediabetes. We develop a supervised learning framework to classify adults as normal, prediabetic, or diabetic using National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey data. The framework uses routinely collected demographic, clinical, and lifestyle variables from 15,356 adults, with glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) used only to define labels and excluded from input features to prevent leakage. We compare conventional machine learning and transformer-based models and examine two binary formulations: normal versus prediabetes, and normal versus combined prediabetes and diabetes. Models are evaluated on a held-out test set using precision, sensitivity, specificity, and F1 score. In the multiclass setting, performance is broadly consistent across models, with accuracy up to 0.72 and macro-averaged F1 of 0.70. Prediabetes remains the most challenging class, with F1 scores of 0.54 to 0.56 for conventional models and 0.53 to 0.55 for transformers, reflecting its overlap with both neighboring states. When the task is reduced to normal versus prediabetes, F1 scores rise modestly to 0.62 to 0.64. A more substantial improvement is observed under a broader screening formulation combining prediabetes and diabetes, with F1 scores of 0.73 to 0.74 across all models. These findings suggest that feature overlap along the biological continuum between normal and diabetic states contributes more to the difficulty of prediabetes detection than model architecture. Multiclass prediction provides a more clinically informative representation of metabolic risk progression but highlights a trade-off between clinically meaningful stratification and predictive accuracy.
zh_abstract: 早期检测糖尿病风险对于预防疾病进展很重要。大多数现有的机器学习方法侧重于二分类，这限制了其捕捉糖尿病前期等中间风险状态的能力。我们开发了一个监督学习框架，利用美国国家健康与营养调查（National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey）数据，将成人分类为正常、糖尿病前期或糖尿病。该框架使用来自15,356名成人的常规采集人口学、临床和生活方式变量，糖化血红蛋白（HbA1c）仅用于定义标签，并从输入特征中排除以防止泄漏。我们比较了传统机器学习模型和基于Transformer的模型，并考察了两种二分类设定：正常 versus 糖尿病前期，以及正常 versus 糖尿病前期与糖尿病合并。模型在留出的测试集上使用精确率、敏感度、特异度和F1分数进行评估。在多分类设定中，各模型性能总体一致，准确率最高达0.72，宏平均F1为0.70。糖尿病前期仍是最具挑战性的类别，传统模型的F1分数为0.54至0.56，Transformer模型为0.53至0.55，反映出其与两个相邻状态均有重叠。当任务简化为正常 versus 糖尿病前期时，F1分数小幅升至0.62至0.64。在将糖尿病前期和糖尿病合并的更广泛筛查设定下观察到更大幅度的改善，所有模型的F1分数为0.73至0.74。这些发现表明，正常与糖尿病状态之间生物连续统上的特征重叠，对糖尿病前期检测难度的贡献大于模型架构。多分类预测为代谢风险进展提供了更具临床信息性的表征，但凸显了临床有意义的分层与预测准确性之间的权衡。

title: Raysemble: Metric 3D Bone Reconstruction from a Single X-ray
zh_title: Raysemble：单张X光重建三维骨骼
summary: 提出从单张X光重建腰椎与骨盆骨骼的度量三维方法，在23例留出患者上优于15种对比方法。
key_points: 单张X光重建8块腰椎与骨盆骨
23例留出患者43次CT生成模拟片
平均Dice 65.24%，HD95 9.09毫米
reason: 新方法且对比充分，但测试集仅23例且为模拟X光，属值得一看
abstract: Raysemble reconstructs eight lumbar and pelvic bones from a single X-ray by separating shape and placement. Each 3D query samples regional and global features at its image projection. A shared decoder predicts normalized bone shapes. Predicted depth and camera geometry determine 3D centers and scales for resampling these shapes onto a common grid in millimeters. Evaluation uses 23 held-out patients with 43 CT scans, each generating one simulated anteroposterior radiograph. Without rigid alignment to CT,Raysemble leads 15 evaluated methods, averaging 65.24% Dice, 9.09 mm HD95, and 3.32 mm ASSD over three random seeds. With identical inputs, it improves Dice over VolumeNeRF by 5.86 percentage points.
zh_abstract: Raysemble通过分离形状和位置，从单张X射线重建八块腰椎和骨盆骨骼。每个3D查询在其图像投影处采样区域特征和全局特征。一个共享解码器预测归一化骨骼形状。预测的深度和相机几何确定3D中心和尺度，以便将这些形状重采样到以毫米为单位的公共网格上。评估使用23名留出患者和43次CT扫描，每次扫描生成一张模拟前后位X线片。在未与CT进行刚性对齐的情况下，Raysemble在15种被评估方法中领先，在三个随机种子上平均达到65.24% Dice、9.09 mm HD95和3.32 mm ASSD。在相同输入下，其Dice较VolumeNeRF提高5.86个百分点。

title: Towards Democratising Low-Data Medical Image Classification: CPU-Trainable ZACH-ViT and Its Geometric Variants
zh_title: CPU可训练的低数据医学图像分类模型
summary: 在七个MedMNIST+与三个外部基准上评测不足26万参数的ZACH-ViT变体，采用每类50张图的低数据协议。
key_points: 模型参数少于26万，可从零在CPU训练
低数据每类50图、5个随机种子
Compact-TransMIL十数据集平均F1最高
reason: 含三个外部基准但模型极小、指标提升有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Medical image classification in resource-constrained settings must contend with limited annotations and computational capacity. We evaluate four ZACH-ViT variants with linear, Euclidean prototype, Poincare and spherical heads alongside two compact multiple-instance-learning baselines. All models are trained from scratch with fewer than 260,000 parameters across seven MedMNIST+ datasets and three external benchmarks (PCam, ISIC2017 and Shenzhen tuberculosis radiographs). The low-data protocol uses 50 training images per class and five seeds, with validation-selected checkpoints at 23 and 47 epochs; a full-data reference uses one seed. Compact-TransMIL achieves the highest ten-dataset mean test Macro-F1 at 23 epochs (53.34%) and with full data (73.93%). At 47 epochs, ZACH-Linear narrowly leads (57.76% versus 57.54% for Compact-TransMIL). Extending training improves Macro-F1 in 239 of 300 paired comparisons. On ISIC2017, hZACH-Spherical has the highest 47-epoch low-data Macro-F1 (44.09% with SD 4.09%), whereas ZACH-EuclideanProto leads with full data (51.27%). We additionally conduct 40 CPU-only training runs on ISIC2017 and Shenzhen using four CPU threads; model-only single-image inference requires approximately 4-9 ms, while image decoding and preprocessing substantially increase end-to-end latency. The results demonstrate the feasibility of CPU-only training on the tested platform and the task- and regime-dependence of compact medical imaging under strict resource constraints.
zh_abstract: 资源受限环境中的医学图像分类必须应对有限的标注和计算能力。我们评估了四种 ZACH-ViT 变体，分别具有线性、欧几里得原型、Poincare 和球面头，并与两个紧凑的多示例学习基线一起评估。所有模型均从头训练，参数少于 260,000 个，覆盖七个 MedMNIST+ 数据集和三个外部基准（PCam、ISIC2017 和 Shenzhen 结核病 X 光片）。低数据协议每类使用 50 张训练图像和五个种子，并在 23 和 47 个 epoch 使用验证选择的检查点；全数据参考使用一个种子。Compact-TransMIL 在 23 个 epoch 时（53.34%）和全数据时（73.93%）取得最高的十数据集平均测试 Macro-F1。在 47 个 epoch 时，ZACH-Linear 略微领先（57.76% 对 Compact-TransMIL 的 57.54%）。延长训练在 300 次配对比较中的 239 次改善了 Macro-F1。在 ISIC2017 上，hZACH-Spherical 具有最高的 47 epoch 低数据 Macro-F1（44.09%，SD 4.09%），而 ZACH-EuclideanProto 在全数据下领先（51.27%）。我们还在 ISIC2017 和 Shenzhen 上使用四个 CPU 线程进行了 40 次仅 CPU 训练运行；仅模型单图像推理约需 4-9 ms，而图像解码和预处理会显著增加端到端延迟。结果表明在测试平台上仅 CPU 训练的可行性，以及在严格资源约束下紧凑医学成像的任务和机制依赖性。

title: Calibration and Conformal Prediction for Medical Question Answering in Arabic and English: Evidence from Two Non-Parallel Benchmarks
zh_title: 阿拉伯语与英语医学问答的校准与共形预测
summary: 评估两个开源权重模型在2816道英文和4927道阿拉伯语医学选择题上的校准与不确定性，温度缩放消除了82%–93%的校准误差。
key_points: Qwen英文准确率0.561、阿拉伯语0.430；Jais为0.369与0.308
四组设置均过度自信，ECE在0.242–0.486之间
分裂共形预测在全部24种设置均达到名义覆盖率
reason: 双基准、设置较全的不确定性分析预印本，方法有新意但无临床结局
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly tested on medical exam questions, but accuracy alone does not show when an answer can be trusted. I study the calibration and uncertainty of two open-weight models, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Jais-adapted-7B-chat (both run in 4-bit precision), on 2,816 English multiple-choice questions from MedMCQA and 4,927 Arabic multiple-choice questions from MedAraBench. Accuracy was 0.561 (English) and 0.430 (Arabic) for Qwen, and 0.369 and 0.308 for Jais. Raw option probabilities were overconfident in all four settings (expected calibration error 0.242 to 0.486), and a single temperature parameter removed 82% to 93% of that error. Split conformal prediction reached its nominal coverage in all 24 settings I tested (within 0.006), but the sets were large when accuracy was low: at 90% coverage, temperature-scaled sets contained on average 63% (Qwen, English), 78% (Qwen, Arabic), 86% (Jais, English) and 89% (Jais, Arabic) of the options. The margin between the top two option probabilities separated correct from incorrect answers best for Qwen on English (AUROC 0.734) and worst for Jais on Arabic (0.579). Answering only the 20% most confident questions lowered Qwen's English error from 0.439 to 0.098. Jais showed a strong prior for option C (49% of English and 60% of Arabic predictions). Scoring Latin letters only cut the Arabic share to 29% but left accuracy, raw ECE and AUROC nearly unchanged. Because the two benchmarks differ in subject, level and number of options, I do not attribute differences between languages to language itself. Code is available at https://github.com/Mariyaaleem/arabic-english-medqa-uncertainty.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地在医学考试题上进行测试，但仅凭准确率并不能说明何时可以信任某个答案。我研究了两个开放权重模型Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Jais-adapted-7B-chat（二者均以4位精度运行）在来自MedMCQA的2,816道英语多项选择题和来自MedAraBench的4,927道阿拉伯语多项选择题上的校准与不确定性。Qwen的准确率为0.561（英语）和0.430（阿拉伯语），Jais为0.369和0.308。原始选项概率在全部四种设置中均过度自信（期望校准误差0.242至0.486），而单一温度参数消除了该误差的82%至93%。拆分共形预测在我测试的全部24种设置中达到其名义覆盖率（误差在0.006以内），但当准确率低时集合很大：在90%覆盖率下，经温度缩放的集合平均包含63%（Qwen，英语）、78%（Qwen，阿拉伯语）、86%（Jais，英语）和89%（Jais，阿拉伯语）的选项。前两个选项概率之间的间隔在Qwen英语上区分正确与错误答案最佳（AUROC 0.734），在Jais阿拉伯语上最差（0.579）。仅回答最自信的20%问题使Qwen的英语错误率从0.439降至0.098。Jais对选项C表现出强先验（英语预测的49%和阿拉伯语预测的60%）。仅对拉丁字母计分将阿拉伯语占比降至29%，但准确率、原始ECE和AUROC几乎不变。由于两个基准在学科、水平和选项数量上不同，我不将语言间差异归因于语言本身。代码见https://github.com/Mariyaaleem/arabic-english-medqa-uncertainty。

title: Constructing and Validating Memorisation Audits for EHR Foundation Models
zh_title: EHR基础模型记忆审计框架的构建与验证
summary: 预印本提出针对EHR基础模型的记忆审计方法，用重建、敏感属性披露与随机金丝雀评估MIMIC-IV训练模型。
key_points: 评估重建、敏感属性披露与患者级金丝雀
训练与留出差异小，敏感披露无超额
过拟合阳性对照验证审计有效性
reason: 有新方法的预印本，含阳性对照但证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Autoregressive electronic health record (EHR) foundation models may disclose training information at inference, yet clinical predictability makes patient-specific memorisation difficult to distinguish from generalisation. We evaluate fixed-window token reconstruction, sensitive-attribute disclosure, and random patient-level canaries in GPT-2-style models trained on MIMIC-IV, across early, best-validation, and final checkpoints. Reconstruction improves with additional context, but training--held-out differences remain small. Trajectory-unique prompts containing limited clinical information produce no excess sensitive disclosure for training patients. In a matched model with random binary patient-level canaries, training-patient label-recovery AUROC increases from 0.512 to 0.549 while held-out recovery remains at chance. An overfit 1,000-patient positive control achieves near-perfect recovery, confirming sensitivity to strong memorisation. These results reveal weak cohort-level memorisation but no reliable patient-level disclosure under the evaluated attacks. They motivate clinically grounded inference-time audits that can detect patient-specific memorisation in existing models without retraining with canaries.
zh_abstract: 自回归电子健康记录（EHR）基础模型可能在推理时泄露训练信息，但临床可预测性使患者特异性记忆难以与泛化区分。我们在 MIMIC-IV 上训练的 GPT-2 风格模型中，评估固定窗口 token 重建、敏感属性泄露和随机患者级 canaries（金丝雀标记），覆盖早期、最佳验证和最终检查点。重建随上下文增加而改善，但训练与留出集之间的差异仍然很小。包含有限临床信息的轨迹唯一提示未对训练患者产生额外敏感泄露。在一个带有随机二元患者级 canaries 的匹配模型中，训练患者标签恢复 AUROC 从 0.512 增至 0.549，而留出患者恢复仍处于随机水平。一个过拟合的 1,000 名患者阳性对照达到近乎完美的恢复，确认了对强记忆的敏感性。这些结果揭示了弱的队列级记忆，但在所评估攻击下没有可靠的患者级泄露。它们推动基于临床的推理时审计，从而无需用 canaries 重新训练即可检测现有模型中的患者特异性记忆。

title: Pathological Micro-Niches and Multimodal Imaging Macro-Niches for Predicting Clinically Significant Prostate Cancer and Metastasis: A Multicenter Study
zh_title: 病理微生态位与影像宏生态位预测前列腺癌的多中心研究
summary: 新注册多中心观察性队列，拟验证原发前列腺癌病理微生态位与mpMRI、PSMA PET/CT影像特征的跨尺度关联。
key_points: 由广西医科大学发起，计划入组2000例
以回顾为主，含可选前瞻性静默验证
当前状态为已启动但未招募，尚无结果
reason: 仅注册信息、无结果，属增量档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Guangxi Medical University; conditions: Prostate Cancer, Prostatic Neoplasms; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 2000; status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING] This is an investigator-initiated, multicenter, observational ambispective cohort study, predominantly retrospective, with an optional prospective non-interventional silent validation. The study tests a cross-scale hypothesis that the pathological micro-niche of the primary prostate tumor (tumor epithelium, invasive front, immune-rich or immune-poor regions, ECM/collagen remodeling, neurovascular neighborhoods, and peritumoral field effect) is associated at the patient level with the imaging macro-niche captured by multiparametric MRI (diffusion, perfusion, heterogeneity, local invasion) and PSMA PET/CT (receptor expression, whole-body lesion distribution, tumor burden). A pathology teacher model provides patient- or lesion-set-level niche representations only during model development; at deployment and validation, only MRI, PSMA PET/CT, and clinical information available before the prediction time point are used, with no voxel-level pathology-to-imaging registration. Under one master protocol with three pre-specified substudies, the system predicts: (A) patient- and lesion-level clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa, ISUP Grade Group 2 or higher) from pre-biopsy MRI; (B) pathological pelvic lymph node metastasis (pN1) after radical prostatectomy with pelvic lymph node dissection, primarily from MRI; and (C) concurrent distant metastasis (M1) and subsequent distant metastasis in baseline M0 patients, primarily from PSMA PET/CT. Models are evaluated for discrimination, calibration, clinical net benefit, uncertainty, abstention, and stability across centers, scanners, tracers, and disease spectra, using locked multicenter external validation and prospective silent validation. Model outputs are never shown to clinicians or patients and do not alter care.

abstract: [Clinical parkinsonism & related disorders] Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used as clinical support tools, yet their performance in Parkinson's disease (PD) management remains insufficiently characterized. We evaluated a general-purpose LLM (Gemini 1.5 Pro) and a medically specialized LLM (OpenEvidence) using 45 synthetic PD vignettes requiring generative assessment and management recommendations. Responses were independently rated by two movement disorders fellows using predefined 5-point Likert scales, with adjudication by a senior specialist when required. Both models demonstrated generally good performance in clinical assessment, whereas management recommendations were less reliable. A modest numerical advantage was observed for the medically specialized model across assessment, plan, and composite outcomes, although no statistically significant differences were identified. Qualitative analysis showed that clinically relevant errors occurred in both models, predominantly reflecting treatment strategy errors. These findings suggest that, in the specific model versions evaluated, LLMs may support clinical reasoning in PD, but require cautious interpretation, particularly for treatment recommendations.

abstract: [Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology] Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) infection, affecting half of the world's population, is the principal cause of peptic ulcer disease and gastric cancer, yet its clinical management is increasingly undermined by the rapidly escalating global burden of antibiotic resistance, the suboptimal accuracy of conventional diagnostic methods, and the declining efficacy of empirical therapeutic regimens. Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly reshaping this landscape, but existing research remains fragmented across single modalities. We propose a conceptual five-module framework that integrates AI approaches across the H. pylori care continuum: (1) global disease burden and the evolutionary dynamics of H. pylori drug resistance; (2) the application of multimodal AI, from convolutional neural networks to vision-language foundation models, for endoscopic early screening, pathological identification, and functional assessment; (3) the harnessing of machine learning (ML) on genomic and electronic health record data to decipher resistance mechanisms and generate personalized eradication regimens; (4) AI-driven vaccine target discovery and generative design, spanning reverse vaccinology to de novo immunogen creation; and (5) a digital closed-loop patient management platform that leverages new media and reinforcement learning to enhance adherence and eradication rates. We further delineate the core challenges of data bias, cross-scenario generalization, and the critical absence of prospective randomized evidence, and propose a future direction anchored in multimodal foundation models, federated learning, and continuous AI quality improvement. Rather than an established clinical pathway, this framework is proposed as a conceptual blueprint that, once prospectively validated, could upgrade AI-enabled H. pylori care from isolated image recognition toward an end-to-end "perception-reasoning-intervention" system, offering a blueprint for precision prevention and control.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology] 幽门螺杆菌（Helicobacter pylori，H. pylori）感染影响全球半数人口，是消化性溃疡病和胃癌的主要病因，然而其临床管理正日益受到全球抗生素耐药负担迅速加重、传统诊断方法准确性欠佳以及经验性治疗方案疗效下降的削弱。人工智能（artificial intelligence，AI）正在迅速重塑这一格局，但现有研究仍分散于单一模态。我们提出一个概念性五模块框架，将AI方法整合到H. pylori全程照护中：（1）全球疾病负担与H. pylori耐药性的演化动态；（2）多模态AI的应用，从卷积神经网络到视觉-语言基础模型，用于内镜早期筛查、病理识别和功能评估；（3）利用基因组和电子健康记录数据上的机器学习（machine learning，ML）来解析耐药机制并生成个体化根除方案；（4）AI驱动的疫苗靶点发现和生成式设计，涵盖从反向疫苗学到从头创建免疫原；（5）一个数字闭环患者管理平台，利用新媒体和强化学习来提高依从性和根除率。我们进一步阐明数据偏倚、跨场景泛化和前瞻性随机证据严重缺乏等核心挑战，并提出一个以多模态基础模型、联邦学习和AI质量持续改进为锚点的未来方向。该框架并非已确立的临床路径，而是作为一个概念性蓝图提出；一旦经过前瞻性验证，它可将AI赋能的H. pylori照护从孤立的图像识别升级为端到端的“感知-推理-干预”系统，为精准预防和控制提供蓝图。
