abstract: [Exploratory research in clinical and social pharmacy] Self-medication is common worldwide and increasingly informed by artificial intelligence (AI) tools, but their intersection is understudied, particularly in conflict-affected settings such as Syria. To assess self-medication among adults living in Syria and their use of AI tools for medication-related information. An online cross-sectional survey of 255 adults (22 February-7 March 2026) assessed self-medication, AI use, trust, pharmacist-AI preferences, and privacy awareness. Analyses comprised descriptive statistics, chi-square tests with Cramér's V, and exploratory principal component analysis (PCA; n = 86 complete cases) with a sensitivity analysis (n = 149). Self-medication was reported by 80.8% of respondents, without a sex difference (p = 0.579), and 30.6% used antibiotics without prescription. AI tools were used for health queries by 61.6% (ChatGPT by 45.5% of all respondents), more often by younger (p = 0.002) and more educated respondents (p < 0.001). Among AI users, 66.2% asked medication-related questions, 68.2% trusted AI information conditionally, and 59.2% preferred pharmacists; in 16 of 17 disagreements, the pharmacist's advice was followed. PCA identified self-medication intensity, health literacy, and AI engagement components; the first two were reproduced in the sensitivity analysis, whereas a weak link between adverse drug reactions and AI engagement was not. In this digitally connected sample, AI-assisted health information seeking was common and coexisted with frequent self-medication and non-prescribed antibiotic use. These cross-sectional associations support digital health literacy initiatives, safeguards within AI platforms, and pharmacist engagement with AI-informed patients.
zh_abstract: [Exploratory research in clinical and social pharmacy] 自我用药在全球范围内普遍存在，并且日益受到人工智能（AI）工具的影响，但二者的交叉领域研究不足，尤其是在叙利亚等受冲突影响的环境中。旨在评估居住在叙利亚的成人中的自我用药情况及其使用AI工具获取药物相关信息的情况。一项针对255名成人的在线横断面调查（2026年2月22日至3月7日）评估了自我用药、AI使用、信任、对药师与AI的偏好以及隐私意识。分析包括描述性统计、采用Cramér's V的卡方检验，以及探索性主成分分析（PCA；n = 86例完整病例），并进行了敏感性分析（n = 149）。80.8%的受访者报告自我用药，无性别差异（p = 0.579），30.6%在无处方情况下使用抗生素。61.6%的受访者使用AI工具进行健康查询（全体受访者中45.5%使用ChatGPT），在较年轻（p = 0.002）和受教育程度较高（p < 0.001）的受访者中更常见。在AI使用者中，66.2%曾询问药物相关问题，68.2%有条件地信任AI信息，59.2%更偏好药师；在17次分歧中有16次遵循了药师的建议。PCA识别出自我用药强度、健康素养和AI参与度成分；前两个成分在敏感性分析中得到重现，而药物不良反应与AI参与度之间的弱关联未得到重现。在这个数字化连接的样本中，AI辅助的健康信息寻求行为很常见，并与频繁的自我用药和无处方抗生素使用并存。这些横断面关联支持数字健康素养倡议、AI平台内的保障措施以及药师与受AI影响患者的互动。

abstract: Smaller language models (SLMs) make it feasible to deploy clinical natural language processing where large proprietary models are too costly, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning allows them to be specialised on commodity hardware. One obstacle persists after training: on medical tasks these models answer at far greater length than the clinical question requires. In clinical decision support and point-of-care use, where time is short, such verbosity is hard to act on even when the underlying reasoning is sound. Existing length-control methods depend on preference optimisation, reward models, or proprietary teachers that undercut the accessibility making SLMs attractive. We introduce Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation (PECA), which adds a single differentiable conciseness term to the QLoRA supervised fine-tuning objective. Because the token count is discrete and non-differentiable, PECA instead raises the end-of-sequence probability once generation exceeds a token budget, a smooth signal optimised during ordinary training, with no preference data, no auxiliary model, and a single commodity GPU. On a 1.7-billion-parameter model fine-tuned on the medical-o1-reasoning-SFT corpus, PECA reduces mean response length by 72.8% while improving multiple-choice diagnostic accuracy from 40.8% to 44.0%. A sweep over the conciseness strength traces an interpretable accuracy-to-length frontier for balancing brevity and diagnostic completeness.
zh_abstract: 较小语言模型（SLMs）使得在大型专有模型成本过高的情况下部署临床自然语言处理成为可行，而参数高效微调使其能够在普通硬件上专用化。训练后仍存在一个障碍：在医学任务上，这些模型的回答长度远超临床问题所需。在临床决策支持和即时医疗使用中，时间紧迫，即使底层推理合理，这种冗长也难以采取行动。现有长度控制方法依赖偏好优化、奖励模型或专有教师模型，这削弱了使 SLM 具有吸引力的可及性。我们提出参数高效简洁性适配（Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation, PECA），它在 QLoRA 监督微调目标中加入一个可微的简洁性项。由于 token 数是离散且不可微的，PECA 改为在生成超过 token 预算后提高序列结束概率，这是一个在普通训练中优化的平滑信号，无需偏好数据、无需辅助模型，仅需单块普通 GPU。在一个在 medical-o1-reasoning-SFT 语料上微调的 17 亿（1.7 billion）参数模型上，PECA 将平均响应长度减少 72.8%，同时将多项选择诊断准确率从 40.8% 提高到 44.0%。对简洁性强度的扫描描绘出可解释的准确率-长度前沿，用于平衡简洁性与诊断完整性。

abstract: Combining vision-language models (VLMs) with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) offers a promising approach to few-shot whole-slide image (WSI) classification in computational pathology. This study evaluates this approach for predicting ethanol drinking status from nonhuman primate liver histology. Adapters are evaluated against non-PEFT configurations on a subset of the Monkey Alcohol Tissue Research Resource (MATRR). All evaluated PEFT configurations achieve higher mean balanced accuracy than the non-PEFT baselines. For example, in the four-shot setting, attention-based multiple instance learning (ABMIL) alone achieves 43.5% mean balanced accuracy, compared with 78.1% after adding an adapter. Qualitative attention analysis shows that textual pathway adaptations produce localized attention heatmaps, while visual pathway adaptations produce more diffuse ones. A pathologist's review identified similar histological features across adaptations.

abstract: The reduced availability of medical datasets represents an important challenge in the development of predictive models for remote healthcare solutions, especially when the available data are imbalanced or difficult to extend through traditional methods. Small Language Models (SLMs) have become a promising alternative to Large Language Models (LLMs) for addressing these limitations due to their lower computational requirements and adaptability to specialized tasks. However, their performance remains highly dependent on the quality and representativeness of the available training data. In this paper, we propose a method for clinical data augmentation based on a fine-tuned Microsoft Phi-2 model that is used to generate synthetic instances, with the purpose of improving deep learning-based model for predicting remotely monitored vital signs. The Phi-2 model was adapted to the medical domain through supervised fine-tuning on the MedQuad dataset, through a Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA)-based method and by applying few-shot prompting techniques. The resulting model was used afterwards in the augmentation of a small-sized dataset, composed of vital sign values and labels associated with pathological and physiological states. The experimental results demonstrate that fine-tuned SLMs improved the performance on medical domain, achieving higher scores for both lexical (ROUGE) and semantic (BERTScore) evaluation metrics compared to the pretrained model. Moreover, the fine-tuned SLM is effective for generating structured synthetic clinical data. When used for data augmentation, the generated dataset improved the performance of a LSTM predictive model, increasing the classification accuracy from 89.0% to 93.7% and showing consistent improvements in precision, recall, and F1-score.
zh_abstract: 医学数据集可用性降低是开发远程医疗解决方案预测模型时的一项重要挑战，尤其是当可用数据不平衡或难以通过传统方法扩展时。小语言模型（Small Language Models, SLMs）由于计算需求较低且可适应专门任务，已成为解决这些局限性的、有前景的大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）替代方案。然而，其性能仍高度依赖于可用训练数据的质量和代表性。本文提出一种基于经过微调的 Microsoft Phi-2 模型的临床数据增强方法，该模型用于生成合成样本，目的是改进用于预测远程监测生命体征的深度学习模型。Phi-2 模型通过基于量化低秩适配（Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation, QLoRA）的方法，并在 MedQuad 数据集上进行监督微调以及应用少样本提示技术，被适配到医学领域。随后，所得模型被用于增强一个小规模数据集，该数据集由生命体征值以及与病理和生理状态相关的标签组成。实验结果表明，经过微调的 SLM 提高了医学领域性能，在词汇（ROUGE）和语义（BERTScore）评价指标上均比预训练模型获得更高分数。此外，经过微调的 SLM 能有效生成结构化合成临床数据。当用于数据增强时，生成的数据集改善了 LSTM 预测模型的性能，将分类准确率从 89.0% 提高到 93.7%，并在精确率、召回率和 F1-score 上表现出一致提升。

abstract: Deep learning (DL) has achieved remarkable success in medical image segmentation by learning data-driven representations from large-scale annotated datasets. However, medical images are often collected independently across clinical sites, resulting in substantial domain shifts due to differences in imaging modalities, acquisition protocols, and intensity distributions. Meanwhile, segmentation classes may vary across sites due to differences in annotation standards, leading to class shifts. These evolving domains and class definitions can substantially degrade segmentation performance on newly encountered data, while sequential adaptation may cause catastrophic forgetting of knowledge acquired from previously encountered domains and classes. Existing incremental learning methods for medical image segmentation primarily address either domain shifts or class shifts, with these two settings largely investigated independently. This separation leaves a critical gap in developing a unified approach that can simultaneously adapt to evolving domains and newly introduced classes while retaining previously acquired knowledge. To address this challenge, we propose Fisher-Guided Continuously Adaptive Representation Learning, a unified framework for domain- and class-incremental 3D volumetric medical image segmentation. FGCARL comprises two key components: Mutual Adaptive Instance Representation (MAIR), which adaptively aligns feature distributions across sequentially encountered domains through bidirectional normalization and denormalization, and Fisher-Guided Knowledge Retention (FGKR), which selectively preserves parameters important for previously learned domains and classes through Fisher-guided regularization. Experimental results demonstrate that FGCARL consistently outperformed state-of-the-art methods, effectively adapting to domain and class shifts while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
zh_abstract: 深度学习（DL）通过从大规模标注数据集中学习数据驱动表示，在医学图像分割中取得了显著成功。然而，医学图像通常由各临床站点独立收集，由于成像模态、采集协议和强度分布的差异，导致显著的域偏移。与此同时，由于标注标准的差异，分割类别可能因站点而异，导致类别偏移。这些不断演变的域和类别定义可能显著降低在新遇到数据上的分割性能，而顺序适应可能导致对先前遇到的域和类别所获得知识的灾难性遗忘。现有的医学图像分割增量学习方法主要解决域偏移或类别偏移，而这两种设置很大程度上被独立研究。这种分离在开发统一方法方面留下了关键空白，该方法能够同时适应不断演变的域和新引入的类别，同时保留先前获得的知识。为应对这一挑战，我们提出Fisher引导的持续自适应表征学习（Fisher-Guided Continuously Adaptive Representation Learning, FGCARL），这是一个用于域增量和类别增量3D体医学图像分割的统一框架。FGCARL包含两个关键组件：互自适应实例表示（Mutual Adaptive Instance Representation, MAIR），通过双向归一化和反归一化自适应对齐顺序遇到的域之间的特征分布；以及Fisher引导知识保留（Fisher-Guided Knowledge Retention, FGKR），通过Fisher引导正则化选择性保留对先前学习域和类别重要的参数。实验结果表明，FGCARL始终优于最先进方法，有效适应域偏移和类别偏移，同时减轻灾难性遗忘。

abstract: Learning a risk-sensitive individualized treatment rule (ITR) with patient covariates is challenging when the treatment criterion depends on the full conditional outcome distribution rather than only its conditional mean. Existing methods are largely criterion-specific, making it difficult to compare multiple treatment criteria within a common pipeline, such as quantiles, conditional value-at-risk (CVaR), and complex preference-based objectives such as cumulative prospect theory. We propose a distribution-first framework for risk-sensitive ITR learning that first estimates treatment-specific conditional outcome distributions and then constructs the target ITR by plug-in criterion evaluation. The proposed framework unifies treatment rule learning across multiple criteria and accommodates hard-to-optimize objectives within the same estimation pipeline. On the theoretical side, it yields a general error propagation result for locally Hölder-stable criteria, linking first-stage distribution estimation error to downstream criterion estimation and treatment regret, together with sharper regret bounds under standard margin conditions. Empirically, we show that the proposed framework outperforms direct criterion-specific methods in multiple settings and further evaluate it on the ACTG175 HIV clinical trial, a randomized study comparing several antiretroviral regimens in HIV-infected adults.
zh_abstract: 当治疗标准取决于完整条件结局分布而非仅条件均值时，利用患者协变量学习风险敏感的个体化治疗规则（ITR）具有挑战性。现有方法大多针对特定标准，难以在共同流程中比较多种治疗标准，例如分位数、条件风险价值（CVaR）以及累积前景理论等复杂偏好目标。我们提出一种分布优先的风险敏感 ITR 学习框架，首先估计治疗特定的条件结局分布，然后通过插入式标准评估构建目标 ITR。所提框架统一了跨多种标准的治疗规则学习，并在同一估计流程中容纳难以优化的目标。在理论方面，它对局部 Hölder 稳定标准给出一般误差传播结果，将第一阶段分布估计误差与下游标准估计和治疗后悔联系起来，并在标准间隔条件下给出更紧的后悔界。在实证方面，我们表明所提框架在多种设置下优于直接针对特定标准的方法，并进一步在 ACTG175 HIV 临床试验上评估，该试验是一项在 HIV 感染成人中比较几种抗逆转录病毒方案的随机研究。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Universidad Católica San Antonio de Murcia; conditions: Impacted Third Molar, Dental Caries, Alveolar Bone Resorption, Root Resorption; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 1188; status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING] Impacted mandibular third molars (wisdom teeth that cannot fully erupt) may damage the adjacent second molar, causing decay on its back surface, loss of the supporting bone or resorption of its root. This retrospective observational study aims to identify which radiographic features of the impacted third molar are associated with a higher risk of pathology in the second molar. The study uses panoramic radiographs (OPG) and cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) scans that were previously obtained for clinical reasons at the UCAM Dental University Clinic (Murcia, Spain) between 2018 and 2026. The position, angulation, depth and contact of the third molar with the second molar are measured, and their relationship with second molar pathology is analysed.
